tei:div.tei:p: (āḥ)༄༅// rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i khrid rim bla ma'i gsung sgros dngos grub myur mgyogs kyi pho nya zhes bya ba bzhugs so// ༈ /bla ma dang rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma dbyer ma mchis pa la phyag 'tshal lo// 'dir gang bshad par bya ba'i chos ni/ rnal 'byor gsang mtha'i rtsa bshad kyi rgyud thams cad kyi snying po phyung ba'i man ngag rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma nyid kyis dpal ldan nā ro ta pa la dngos su gnang ba'i gdams pa 'di yin la/ nā ro ta pa de nyid la slob ma'i mchog 'phags yul na yongs su grags pa'i paṇa chen bcu gnyis tsam dang*/ bod yul nas dka' ba du ma spyad nas byon pa'i thugs sras mar pa lo tsā rnams yod kyang de dag la ma gnang bar bal po pham thing ba sku mched la slob bshad kyi tshul du gnang ba'i zab chos klog skya shes rab brtsegs dang*/ mal lo tsā ba las rim par brgyud de/ sa skya pa chen po la bka' babs pa'i gdams pa khyad par can yin la/ sa skya pa chen po nyid la spyir bla med dang 'brel ba'i gdams pa rgya mtsho tsam yod pa las/ mchog tu gyur pa gser chos bcu bzhi'am bcu gsum gyi nang mtshan mchog bsgrubs pas thun mong zhar las 'byung ba dmar mo skor gsum/ de'i nang nas kyang mchog tu gyur pa nā ro mkha' spyod kyi gdams pa yin la/ 'di 'chad pa la don gsum ste/ gang gis nyams su len pa'i gang zag des nyams su blang ba'i lam/ nyams su blang ba'i lam de'i 'bras bu dang gsum/ dang po la smin lam 'jug rung gi gang zag dang*/ grol lam bsgom rung gi gang zag gnyis las/ dang po ni/ spyir rdo rje theg pa nas bshad pa'i mtshan nyid thams cad tshang zhing*/ 'khor lo bde mchog lū nag dril gsum gyi dkyil 'khor du dbang bzhi thob pa ni rab/ gsum char gyi dbang ma thob na'ang lū nag gang rung gi rdul tshon nam ras bris su thob pa ni 'bring*/ de'i dbang ye ma thob kyang ma rgyud kye rdor lta bu'i dbang tsam thob pa ni tha ma'o// gnyis pa grol lam bsgom rung gi gang zag ni/

sngar gyi de'i steng du sgrub pa po rang gi sems nyid rdo rje rnal 'byor mar ye gdod ma nas gnas pa de ngo sprod pa'i ched du sin+dhu ra'i dkyil 'khor du rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i byin rlabs legs par thob cing*/ rgyun du chag med du nyams su len pa'i gang zag cig yin la/ de la yang gzhi'i bsnyen pa mthar phyin nas/ tshes bcu rnam pa gnyis kyis mchod pa la brtson par byas pas/ rdo rje rnal 'byor ma tha mal bud med kyi gzugs kyis rang gi mdun du byung ba ngo shes nas phyag 'tshal/ gsol ba btab pas/ des sgrub pa po'i lag pa'i mkhrig ma nas bzung ste mkha' spyod du 'khrid par byed pa ni gang zag rab/ de lta bu ma byung na gzhi'i bsnyen pa gnyis la sogs pa dang*/ khyad par sin+dhū ra'i bsgrub par byas te/ dpral bar sin+dhū ras dga' ba 'khyil pa bris la/ rang nyid rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i nga rgyal gyis bud med mang po 'du ba'i gnas kun nyul pa na/ gang rdo rje rnal 'byor ma yin pa de'i dpral bar sin+dhū ra'i dga' ba 'khyil pa 'phos yong ba yin pas/ nam byung ba na de nyid la gsol ba btab pa na/ de nyid kyis bdag gi lag pa'i mkhrig ma nas bzung ste/ mkha' spyod du 'khrid par byed pa ni 'bring*/ de ltar byas kyang ma byung na/ sgyid lug pa spangs te rgyun du bzlas bsgom la 'bad par byas pas/ nam zhig shi 'phos te bar dor slebs pa'i tshe yang bzlas bsgom byed pa'i snang ba 'char la/ de'i tshe mkha' spyod nas dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma'i tshogs rnams kyis 'ong ste/ bsgrub pa po de seṅge'i khri'i steng du bzhag steng du gdugs phub/ 'phan dang rol mo la sogs pa'i sgras mchod cing me tog gi char 'bebs shing mkha' spyod du 'khrid par byed pa ni tha ma'o// de ltar ma byung na skye ba phyi ma rnams su rnal 'byor ma'i bzlas bsgom byed pa'i rigs su skyes nas/

nam zhig na mkha' spyod du bgrod pa ni gang zag shin tu tha shal ba yin no// gnyis pa ni/ de bzhi char gyis thun mong du nyams su blang rgyu'i chos la/ nyal dang ldang dang bdud rtsi myong*// tshad med bla ma bdag lhar bskyed// 'gro ba dag pa'i rnal 'byor dang*// dpa' bo dpa' mos byin gyis brlabs// ngag bzlas yid bzlas gnyis gcig yin// bsam gyi mi khyab rnal 'byor dang*// spyod lam gyi ni rnal 'byor te// de ltar rnal 'byor bcu gcig go /zhes rnal 'byor bcu gcig gi nyams len yod pa las/ dang po ni/ sgrub pa po spros pa la mi dga' bar stong nyid la mos pa yin na/ bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i rnal 'byor yan chad bsdus pa'i stong nyid de'i ngang la rnam rtog gzhan gyis bar ma chod par byas nas nyal/ spros pa la dga' zhing bskyed rim la mos na/ gnas khang chos 'byung du gsal ba'i nang du seṅges btegs pa'i rin po che'i khri'i steng du rang nyid rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i sku rgyan dang phyag mtshan spangs pa/ grogs yod na yang de ltar du gsal gdab/ rang nyid kyi sngas mgor seṅges btegs pa'i rin po che'i khri'i steng du dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ngo bo rtsa ba'i bla ma rje btsun rdo rje chos kyi rnam pa can du gsal btab nas nyal/ gnyid sad byung na yang de ltar du gsal gdab/ de dag gi sbyang gzhi ni snod kyi 'jig rten 'jig pa dang*/ bcud kyi sems can 'chi ba dang*/ rang gzhan thams cad dge sbyor gyis rtsis ma zin par tha mal du gnyid log pa rnams yin la/ sbyong byed ni thams cad 'dir nyal ba'i rnal 'byor du bsgyur nas nyams su len pa yin la/ sbyangs 'bras ni sangs rgyas so// gnyis pa ldang ba'i rnal 'byor ni/ gang zag snga ma'i ldang lugs la/ sang tho rangs mkha' spyod kyi dpa' bo dang dpa' mo rnams kyis ḍā ma ru'i sgra 'khrol te byung ba'i rkyen gyis gnyid sad pa na/

chu las nya 'phar ba'i tshul du rgyan dang lag cha spangs pa'i rnal 'byor ma'i skur ldang*/ gang zag phyi ma'i ldang lugs ni/ gnas khang chos 'byung dang rang yang rnal 'byor ma'i skur gsal btab pas ldang ngo*// de dag gi sbyang gzhi ni/ snod kyi 'jig rten chags pa dang*/ bcud kyi sems can skye ba dang*/ rang gzhan thams cad la dge sbyor gyis rtsis ma zin par tha mal gyi snang ba bun lang long 'char ba rnams yin la/ sbyong byed ni/ de thams cad 'dir ldang ba'i rnal 'byor du bsgyur bas nyams su len pa yin no// gsum pa bdud rtsi myong ba ni/ sang snga dror bdud rtsi ril bu btab pa'i nang mchod la g.yon pa'i mtheb srin gyis reg la thig pa lce thog tu myang bas mgrin pa'i ya ra la wa'i rtsa bzhi'i nang nas mar song ste lus kyi nang thams cad zag med kyi bde bas gang*/ bde chen gyi ye shes rgyud la skyes/ bdud rtsi'i dwangs ma thams cad snying ga'i bam̐ yig la thim pas/ bam̐ yig nyi ma bye ba'i gzi brjid dang ldan par bsam/ sbyang gzhi ni/ 'dod sred kyis kun nas bslangs te zas za ba dang khrus byed pa la sogs pa yin la/ sbyong byed ni/ 'dir bdud rtsi myong ba'i rnal 'byor du bsgyur nas dag pa'i snang bas rgyas 'debs pa yin no// 'di la 'khor lo bde mchog gi zab gnad dga' ba gsum yang tshang ba yin te/ lus rdo rje rnal 'byor mar bsgom pa ni sku'i dga' ba/ mgrin par 'od dpag med kyi gnas yin pas der bdud rtsi myong ba ni gsung gi dga' ba/ bdud rtsi'i dwangs ma thams cad snying ga'i bam̐ yig la thim pa ni thugs kyi dga' ba'o// bzhi pa tshad med kyi rnal 'byor la/ lam log pa las khyad par du bya ba skyabs 'gro'i khrid/ dman pa las khyad par du bya ba sems bskyed kyi khrid/ 'gal rkyen sdig sgrib sbyong ba yi ge brgya pa'i khrid/ mthun rkyen tshogs gsog pa maṇ+ḍal gyi khrid dang bzhi/

dang po ni/ rang gang du gnas pa'i sa phyogs de baiḍūr+ya'i sa gzhi la gser gyis mig mangs ris su bres pa/ mnan na nem pa/ bteg na spar ba/ reg na phun sum tshogs pa'i bde ba skyed pa/ de'i dbus su seṅges btegs pa'i rin po che'i khri/ sna tshogs pad+ma dang zla ba'i gdan gyi steng du/ skyabs su 'gro ba'i yul ni/ da ltar gyi rtsa ba'i bla ma 'di nyid rje btsun rdo rje chos kyi rnam pa can du bzhugs pa la skyabs gnas kun tshang ba yin te/ bla ma thams cad thugs rgyud gcig pas bla ma kun 'dus kyi ngo bo yang yin/ de nyid kyi phung po lnga rgyal ba rigs lnga yin pas/ sangs rgyas kun 'dus kyang yin/ thugs rgyud la bzhugs pa'i spangs rtogs kyi yon tan rnams chos dkon mchog yin pas chos/ phyi nang gi skye mched rnams sems dpa' dang sems ma'i ngo bo yin pas dge 'dun kun 'dus kyang yin/ mkha' 'gro chos skyong rnams bka' nyan gsung bstod kyi tshul du bka' 'khor na gnas pas mkha' 'gro chos skyong yang tshang ba yin/ skyabs su 'gro mkhan ni/ rang nyid kyi g.yas su pha/ g.yon du ma/ mdun du rang nyid la gnod byed kyi dgra 'dre/ mtha' skor kun tu rigs drug bar do dang bcas pa'i sems can thams cad ston mo chen po la khrom tshogs pa bzhin khrig mer te gang bar bsam/ skyabs su 'gro ba'i tshul ni/ bla ma la lam gyi 'dren pa/ sangs rgyas la lam gyi ston pa/ chos la lam dngos/ dge 'dun la lam gyi zla grogs zhu snyam pa'i sgo nas/ rang nyid kyis byang drangs pa'i sems can thams cad kyis skyabs 'gro byed pa'i sgra di ri ri yod par bsams la/ skyabs 'gro bzhi skor ram drug skor brgya rtsa dang stong rtsa la sogs pa bya/ de yang kha tsam tshig tsam ma yin par/ snying khong rus pa'i gting nas khyed shes khyed mkhyen skyabs mgon re sa gzhan na med snyam du dkon mchog la blo ling nge bkal ba'i go cha bgos te/

dper na khang pa'am brag phug la char pa las skyob pa'i nus pa yod kyang*/ yid gnyis the tshom byas nas der ma zhugs na/ kha nas khang pa dang brag phug lan brgyar bzlas kyang char pas gdungs pa la mi phan pa bzhin no// des na skyabs yul dkon mchog rnams kyis rgyu 'bras kyi chos thams cad lag mthil du skyu ru ra bzhag pa bzhin mkhyen pas na mkhyen pa'i spyan yang mnga'/ sems can thams cad la bu gcig pa ltar shas mi bzod pa lta bu'i thugs rje yod pas na brtse ba yang mnga'/ mkhyen pa dang brtse ba yod kyang nus pa med na ma lag zhwa ma'i bu chus khyer ba bzhin du skyob mi nus pa la nus pa yang tshad med pa mnga' bas/ bla ma dang dkon mchog la yid gnyis dang the tshom spangs te/ sgo gsum 'jug pa rtse gcig tu dril nas skyabs su song na phan yon bsam gyis mi khyab cing*/ sdug bsngal rgyu dang bcas pa las skyob nus pa yin no// sems bskyed dang rdor sems kyi bsgom bzlas spyi dang 'dra/ lnga pa maṇ+ḍal bla ma'i rnal 'byor ni/ rang sems dang rdor sems bsres pa'i stong nyid de'i ngang las/ mdun gyi nam mkhar seṅges bteg pa'i rin po che'i khri sna tshogs pad+ma dang zla ba'i gdan gyi steng du/ rtsa ba'i bla ma dpa' bo rdo rje chos kyi rnam pa can du bskyed cing gsol ba gdab pa ni thun mong ba yin la/ thun mong ma yin pa ni sngar gyi gdan gyi steng du rtsa ba'i bla ma sangs rgyas rdo rje chos kyi rnam pa can sku mdog dmar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ g.yas rdo rje dang g.yon dril bu thugs kar bsnol nas 'dzin pa/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa/ dbu skra ral pa'i cod pan can/ gzhon nu lo bcu drug lon pa'i na tshod dang ldan pa/ dar gyi na bza' dang rus pa dang rin po che'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ de'i mdun nas brtsams te g.yon skor du gdan de 'dra ba re re'i steng du sangs rgyas rdo rje 'chang nas bzung ste 'jam pa'i dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug gi bar gyi brgyud pa'i bla ma thams cad dpa' bo rdo rje chos kyi rnam pas mtha' skor du bzhugs par bsam/

de thams cad kyi gnas gsum du yi ge 'bru gsum/ thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas/ rtsa brgyud kyi bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas byang sems mkha' 'gro chos skyong thams cad tshur 'dus/ bla ma thams cad la cha tshang ba re thim pas/ thams cad skyabs gnas kun 'dus kyi ngo bor bsams nas/ gang gi drin gyis bde chen nyid// ces sogs dang*/ rdo rje 'chang chen rdo rje rnal 'byor ma// zhes sogs kyi brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs rnams ngag nas 'don cing*/ mtho ru btang ngam dma' btang rung khyed shes khyed mkhyen snyam pas gsol ba drag tu 'debs/ de nas rang nyid la chags pa skye ba'i yul yid du 'ong ba'i dngos po khang zhing gnyen bshes la sogs pa thams cad bla ma la phul la/ bla mas bdag gir mdzad pas chags pa'i rnam rtog thams cad rang grol du song bar bsam/ de bzhin du zhe sdang skye ba'i yul rang nyid la gnod byed kyi mi dang mi ma yin pa la sogs pa dang*/ gti mug skye ba'i yul bar ma'i 'gro ba la sogs pa thams cad phul la/ de thams cad bla mas bdag gir mdzad pas zhe sdang dang gti mug gi rnam rtog thams cad rang grol du song bar bsam/ de nas snying gar rang gi sems nyid kyi ngo bo rdo rje rnal 'byor ma mtheb sor gyi tshad tsam gnas pa de nyid spyi bo tshangs pa'i bu ga rgya mthongs kha phye ba lta bu'i nang nas yar song ste/ rtsa ba'i bla ma dang zhal sbyor du bzhugs pa la/ slar phyi mig bltas pas/ rang gi phung po de nyid che ba snum pa/ tsho bar 'dug pa la/ sngar lus ji snyed cig blangs kyang don med du song*/ da lan don can bya'o snyam nas gri gug gis smin mtshams/ rna ltag g.yas g.yon gnyis/ ltag pa rnams su reg pa tsam byas pas/ thod pa de nyid bog yong la khad yod pa la/ lag pas blangs te/ stong gsum gyi khyon dang mnyam par gyur pa de nyid mi mgo'i sgyed pu gsum gyi steng du bkal la/ lag na yod pa'i gri gug gis rkang pa g.yon pa dum bu gsum du gtubs nas thod pa'i nang du bskyur/

de bzhin du rkang pa g.yas dang lag pa gnyis kyang dum bu gsum gsum du gtubs la thod pa'i nang du bskyur/ nang khrol don snying rnams kyang dum bur gtubs nas thod pa'i nang du bskyur/ de bzhin du mgo bo'i lhag ma yang thod pa'i nang du bskyur bas/ sha'i ri bo khrag gi rgya mtsho rus pa'i gram rul dang bcas pa'i thod pa stong gsum gyi rgya khyon dang mnyam pa la/ 'og nas me rang 'bar du byung bas de rnams khol zhing zhu bas/ zag med kyi bdud rtsi kha dog dkar ba/ dri zhim pa/ ro mngar ba/ reg bya bsil ba/ nus pa shi nas zhag bdun song ba yang gso nus pa'i bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur par bsams la/ 'bru gsum gyis byin gyis brlabs nas/ rang gi lag na yod pa'i thod pas bdud rtsi nas bcus te 'bru gsum gyi sngags dang bcas te rtsa ba'i bla ma'i zhal du lan bdun gsol nas/ ljags rdo rje'i 'od kyi sbu gu can gyis gsol te/ thugs rgyud zag med kyi bde bas gang*/ bdag la shin tu mnyes pas mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub thams cad da lta nyid du stsol ba'i bdag nyid can du bsam/ rang gi snying ga nas mchod pa'i lha mo lag na thod pa thogs pa du ma spros nas/ de rnams kyi thod pas bdud rtsi nas bcus te/ brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams kyi zhal du gsol bas zag med kyi bde bas thugs rgyud dgang*/ bdag la shin tu mnyes te/ bde chen lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes da lta nyid du stsol ba'i bdag nyid can du bsam/ lha mo rnams slar tshur 'dus nas rang nyid la thim/ yang snying ga nas lha mo du ma spros nas de rnams kyi thod pas bdud rtsi bcus te/ rtsa brgyud kyi bla ma gzhan rnams dang*/ yi dam dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs sangs rgyas byang sems mkha' 'gro chos skyong rnams sprin phung gtib pa bzhin bzhugs pa rnams kyi zhal du gsol/ de thams cad thugs rgyud zag med kyi bde bas gang*/

lha mo rnams slar tshur 'dus/ yang snying ga nas lha mo du ma spros nas/ de rnams kyi thod pas bdud rtsi bcus te/ yul bdag gnas bdag gzhi bdag rnams kyi zhal du gsol bas/ de rnams zag med kyi bde bas rgyud gang zhing*/ rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i skur gyur nas/ bdag gi chos sgrub pa'i stong grogs byed par bsam/ slar lha mo rnams tshur 'dus/ yang snying ga nas mchod pa'i lha mo lag na thod pa thogs pa du ma tshad med dpag med spros nas/ de rnams kyi thod pas bdud rtsi bcus te/ rigs drug bar do dang bcas pa'i sems can thams cad la byin pas/ thams cad zag med kyi bde bas rgyud gang bas sems rtog med chos kyi sku dang*/ lus zag med bde chen rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i skur gyur nas/ rang rang so so'i gnas dag pa'i zhing du sems can gyi don gyi phyir du 'phur song bar bsam/ mchod pa'i lha mo rnams slar rang nyid la bsdu/ de nas bla ma la maṇ+ḍal tshom bu bdun ma dang*/ so bdun ma rnams mang nyung ji ltar rigs pa 'bul/ shes na gang gi mchod rdzas ma dang thos pa rgya mtsho ma yang byas la/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ngo bo bla ma rin po che la gsol ba 'debs so// bdag la dbang bskur ba stsal du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ bla ma'i dpral ba'i oṃ yig dkar po las 'od zer dkar po 'phros/ bdag gi dpral bar thim pas lus kyi sgo nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib thams cad dag bum pa'i dbang thob/ bla ma'i sku'i byin rlabs lus la zhugs par bsam/ dbang gong ma gsum len tshul yang de'i rigs 'gre/ de dag gi sbyang gzhi ni/ skye ba'i srid pa dang skye ba snga ma rnams su yul dag pa lha dang bla ma nas/ yul ma dag pa ldang pa'i srin bu'i bar yan chad la brten nas las ngan ji snyed bsags pa thams cad sbyong bar byed cing*/ gzhung gzhan dang bstun na bsod nams tshogs bsags kyang yin no// de rnams ni bla ma bskyed pa'i zhal shes yin la/

bstim pa'i zhal shes ni/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ngo bo bla ma rin po che la phyag 'tshal zhing skyabs su mchi'o// bdag gi rgyud byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ sangs rgyas rdo rje 'chang 'od du zhu nas/ rdo rje rnal 'byor ma la thim nas/ rje btsun blo gsal rgya mtsho 'od du zhu nas/ 'jam pa'i dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug la thim/ de nyid 'od du zhu nas rtsa ba'i bla ma la thim/ rtsa ba'i bla ma yang yar gdan seng khri nas/ mar spyi bo nas 'od du zhu nas/ thugs ka'i thad du 'od zer dmar po bde ba chen po'i rang bzhin du gyur pa de bdag gi spyi bo nas mar thim/ snying gar bde khril gyis byung nas bam̐ yig la thim/ bam̐ yig je cher song nas sngags phreng rnams kyang bam̐ yig tu song*/ de nas zla ba chos 'byung dang lus kyi nang dang gnas khang la sogs pa dang*/ mthar stong gsum gyi 'jig rten gyi khams dang*/ nam mkha'i khams thams cad kyang bam̐ yig tu song ba la sems gtad nas ji tsam gnas kyi bar lhod kyis 'jog bam̐ yig kyang nam mkha' la 'ja' yal ba ltar song nas mi dmigs pa stong pa nyid kyi ngang la lhod de 'jog de dag gi sbyang gzhi ni 'chi ba'i srid pa sbyang zhing*/ gzhung gzhan dang bstun na ye shes tshogs bsags 'dis mtshon pa yin no// de ltar bla ma'i rnal 'byor bsgom dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan ni/ sangs rgyas thob pa la sems nyid lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes rtogs dgos la/ de rtogs pa yang bla ma dam pa'i man ngag dang thabs bsod nams kyi tshogs rgya chen po rdzogs pa la brten dgos te/ brtag gnyis las/ gzhan gyis brjod min lhan cig skyes// gang du yang ni mi rnyed de// bla ma'i dus thabs bstan pa dang*// bdag gi bsod nams las shes bya// zhes dang*/ mdo sdud pa las kyang*/ ji srid dge ba'i rtsa ba yongs su ma rdzogs par// de srid stong nyid dam pa de ni rtogs mi 'gyur// zhes gsungs so// bsod nams kyi tshogs rdzogs byed kyi thabs kyang bla ma'i rnal 'byor las lhag pa med de/

mtshan dang dpe byad ldan pa yi// sku ni bskal par bsgoms pa bas// bla ma dran pas bsod nams che// zhes dang*/ gsang 'dus las/ sangs rgyas gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed la mchod pa byas pa bas/ bla ma'i ba spu'i bu ga gcig la til mar gyis byugs pas phan yon che'o// zhes pa la sogs pa mdo rgyud thams cad nas mthun par gsungs so// 'o na bla ma dang sangs rgyas gnyis kyi nang nas bla ma yul lhag pa yin nam snyam na de gnyis spangs rtogs la khyad par med mod/ rang nyid la sangs rgyas kyi sku dngos su snang ba dang*/ gsung dngos su thos pa'i skal ba ma byung ba la/ rang dang skal ba mnyam pa bla ma'i skur bzhengs nas chos dngos su ston par mdzad pas na/ sku drin gyi ngos nas bla ma lhag pa yin gsungs so// drug pa bdag lhar bskyed pa ni/ sbyang gzhi ngos bzung na/ phung khams skye mched la sogs pa ma dag pa 'khor bas bsdus pa'i chos rnams ni rgya che ba'i sbyang gzhi/ rtsa gsum 'khor lo lnga ni zab pa'i sbyang gzhi/ sems nyid lhan cig skyes pa ni mthar thug gi sbyang gzhi yin la/ sbyong byed kyi lha rdo rje rnal 'byor ma la dbye na/ rang sems spros pa'i mtha' thams cad dang bral ba ni gsang ba'i rdo rje rnal 'byor ma/ lte ba'i rtsa mdud gru gsum gyi nang na ma las thob pa'i khams nyis dwangs sum dwangs kyis khrig mer te gang ba a thung shad kyi rnam pa can nam chos 'di pa thun mong ma yin pa la/ bam̐ yig gi rnam pa can ni nang gi rdo rje rnal 'byor ma/ phyi rol 'og min na bzhugs pa'i rje btsun ma ni lhan skyes kyi rdo rje rnal 'byor ma/ yul nyer bzhi dang gnas sum cu rtsa bdun na bzhugs pa'i sprul ba'i dpa' bo dang dpa' mo rnams ni zhing las skyes pa'i rdo rje rnal 'byor ma/ ma mkha' 'gro ma yin pa'i rigs su skyes pa rnams ni rigs las skyes pa'i rdo rje rnal 'byor ma/ yul dang yul gru thams cad na gnas pa'i bud med rnams ni las las skyes pa'i rdo rje rnal 'byor ma/

rang nyid rdo rje rnal 'byor mar bsgom pa ni sngags las skyes pa'i rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'o// de ltar na rang gi sems nyid ye gdod ma nas rdo rje rnal 'byor ma yin pa de/ bla mas byin rlabs kyi dus su yin par ngo sprod/ rang nyid kyis kyang yin par ngo shes nas de'i rgyun skyong ba la bskyed rdzogs kyi nyams len byas pas/ phyi rol gyi dpa' bo dang dpa' mo rnams dbang du 'du/ de rnams dbang du 'dus pas 'og min gyi rdo rje rnal 'byor mas byin gyis rlobs/ de byin gyis brlabs pas rang sems la lhan skyes kyi rtogs pa 'char la/ de ni byin brlabs yas rlob dang rtogs pa mas 'char zhes pa'i don to// bdag bskyed dngos ni/ rang gi snying gar e bye ru'i mdog can gnyis brtsegs las/ chos 'byung gru gsum gnyis brtsegs/ chos 'byung phyi ma de dwangs gsal 'od kyi rang bzhin rnyog pa med pa'i rtse mo mdun la bstan pa/ zur gnyis ldeb la bstan pa/ rtsa ba phra ba gsang gnas su zug pa/ gdengs kha che ba gyen du bstan pa/ chos 'byung nang ma zur gsum phyogs la bstan pa/ de'i kha mtshams 'phel kha che ba'i thad du zla ba'i dkyil 'khor dkar bsil nya gang ba/ de'i dbus su bam̐ yig gi mthar g.yon skor du sngags phreng kha dog dmar po gyen du langs pa/ de yang bam̐ yig gi mdun du oṃ gsum de'i 'khris su sarba log pas/ rbas de'i 'khris su bud+dha log pas d+dhabu de'i 'khris su ki ḍā de'i 'khris su ye nī de'i 'khris su dz+rab de'i 'khris su r+ṇawa de'i 'khris su ye nī de'i 'khris su dz+rab de'i 'khris su ro bai de'i 'khris su ye nī tsa de'i 'khris su hūm̐ gsum dang phaṭa gsum rnams de'i 'khris su hā swā/ oṃ dang po'i rtsa bar slebs pa legs par bsam/ 'di'i sbyang gzhi ni bar do'i srid pa sbyong bar byed pa yin no// sngags phreng las 'od zer 'phros/

sdig pa/ sgrib pa/ rnam smin/ gdos bcas/ sha khrag gi phung po dang bcas pa 'od gsal stong pa nyid du sbyangs lus 'od kyi gong bur gyur/ de'i ngang las sgrub pa po 'khor bar gnas kyang 'khor ba'i skyon gyis ma gos pa'i brdar/ sna tshogs pad+ma dang byang chub kyi sems kyi myu gu 'phel zhing smin pa'i rtags su nyi ma dang 'jigs byed dus mtshan dang bcas pa'i steng du/ rang nyid rdo rje rnal 'byor ma sku mdog pad+ma rā ga'i mdog ltar dmar ba ba spu'i bu ga thams cad nas 'od zer dmar po 'phro bas bskal pa'i me dpung lta bu'i gzi brjid can/ chos thams cad de bzhin nyid du ro gcig pa'i brdar zhal gcig bden pa gnyis zung du 'jug pa'i brdar phyag gnyis/ nga rgyal la sogs pa skyon thams cad gcod pa'i brdar g.yas pas rdo rjes mtshan pa'i gri gug thur du brkyangs nas mgo 'khor ba'i phyogs la 'jol thabs su bsnams pa/ mkha' spyod kyi dngos grub brnyes pa'i brdar g.yon pas zla ba ltar dkar ba'i thod pa nang bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin gyi khrag gis gang ba steng gi phyogs su bzung ba/ bde chen gyi ye shes brnyes pa'i rtags su thod pa g.yon du cung zad yo nas khrag gi rgyun 'bab pa zhal gyen du phyogs pas gsol ba/ rang nyid shes rab ma yin pa'i brdar zhal g.yon du phyogs pa/ thabs he ru ka dang ya ma bral ba'i brdar phrag pa g.yon du kha ṭ+wāṃ ga yu ba dkar po brgyad gzhogs byas pa lus tshad dang mnyam pa rtsa ba la rdo rje phyed pas mtshan pa/ rtse mo sna tshogs rdo rje dang de'i steng du bum pa/ de'i khar thod pa skam rlon 'dres ma sum brtsegs kyi khar rdo rje rtse lnga pa reng pos mtshan pa/ sku gsung thugs kyi gsang ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i brdar ḍā ma ru dang dril bu dang 'phan rtse gsum pa la sogs pa 'phyang ba/ rtsa ba mdun la bstan pa/ rtse mo rgyab la bstan nas phrag par bsnams pa'i tshul gyis 'dzin pa/

ye shes lnga'i yon tan rdzogs pa'i rtags su thod skam lngas dbu la brgyan pa/ de yang leb mo sor mo bcu gnyis pa/ kha mig gi rnam pa yod pa/ nang gi ā li kā li lnga bcu dag pa'i brdar thod skam lnga bcu brla nas phrag pa'i bar do shal du 'phyang ba/ dga' ba bcu drug rgyas pa'i brdar gzhon nu lo bcu drug gi na tshod can/ kun 'dzin gyi rtog pa thams cad kyi mdud pa grol ba'i brdar dbu skra bung ba ltar gnag pa sil bur gyur pas sku sked yan chad khebs pa/ snying rje chen pos sems can thams cad rjes su 'dzin pa'i brdar zhabs g.yas brkyang bas dus mtshan ma dmar mo gri thod 'dzin pa gan rkyal du bsgyel ba'i nu ma'i steng nas mnan pa/ de yang nu ma 'dod chags skye ba'i gnas yin pas de mnan pa yin no// shes rab chen pos 'khor ba'i phyogs su ma lhung ba'i brdar zhabs g.yon bskum pas 'jigs byed nag po mgo bo rgyab tu bltabs nas snying ga'i thad du dpral ba nas jir gyis mnan pa/ de yang snying ga zhe sdang skye ba'i gnas dang dpral ba phrag dog skye ba'i gnas yin pas de gnyis mnan pa'o// spyi bor rus pa'i 'khor lo drwa mig sum cu so gnyis pa/ skra thams cad drwa mig gi nang nas yar drangs pa/ rna ba gnyis la rus pa'i a long gnyis brtsegs rus thung dang bcas pa/ mgrin par rus pa'i gzhung gsum drwa mig bcu drug pa/ lte bar rus pa'i gzhung gsum drwa mig drug cu rtsa bzhi/ smad rgyan nam 'og pag byin pa tsam du slebs pa/ de'i spyi gtsug tu rang chas kyi rigs bdag rnam snang he ru ka dkar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyis 'khor lo dang dril bu thugs kar bsnol nas 'dzin pa/ zhabs g.yas brkyang g.yon bskum pa rin po che'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ sku ye shes kyi me dpung 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa legs par gsal gdab/ 'dis ni skye ba'i srid pa sbyong bar byed do// yang 'di la 'khor lo sdom pa'i zab gnad bdag gzhan gyi gzhi sbyang*/

bsgyur zhes bya ba'i bdag gi gzhi sbyang bsgyur gnyis tshang ba yin te/ sngags phreng las 'od 'phros nas sdig sgrib rnam smin gyi phung po dang bcas pa stong pa nyid du sbyang ba ni bdag gi gzhi sbyang ba dang*/ de'i ngang las rang nyid rje btsun ma'i sku zhal phyag rgyan cha lugs yongs su rdzogs pa dang ldan par bskyed pa ni bdag gi gzhi bsgyur ba yin no// bdun pa 'gro ba dag pa'i rnal 'byor ni/ snying ga'i sngags phreng las 'od zer 'phros/ lus kyi nang thams cad gang*/ ba spu'i bu ga thams cad nas phar song*/ sems can thams cad la phog pas sdig sgrib rnam smin gyi phung po dang bcas pa skad cig nyid la sbyangs/ thams cad rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i sku rgyan cha lugs zhal phyag yongs su rdzogs par gyur/ 'di la gzhan gyi gzhi sbyang bsgyur gnyis tshang ba yin no// 'dir lus dkyil gyi lha gsal gdab pa ni/ chos 'byung gi steng zla ba'i dbus su bam̐ yig gi ngo bo rnal 'byor ma dmar mo/ bam̐ yig gi srog ya ra la wa bzhi las/ shar du ya'i ngo bo rnal 'byor ma dkar mo/ g.yon du ra'i ngo bo ljang gu/ rgyab tu la'i ngo bo dmar mo/ g.yas su wa'i ngo bo rnal 'byor ma ser mo/ mtha'i sngags phreng so gnyis kyang re re nas rnal 'byor ma dmar mo re re ste/ kun dril bas lus dkyil gyi lha so bdun legs par gsal gdab/ 'di legs par bsgoms na nang gi gnas so bdun gyi rlung sems thams cad dbu mar thim nas sa lam bgrod cing*/ phyi rol gyi yul so bdun na bzhugs pa'i dpa' bo dang dpa' mo rnams dbang du 'du ba yin no// gsungs so// brgyad pa dpa' bo dpa' mos byin gyis brlabs pa ni/ rang gi snying ga'i bam̐ yig las 'od zer dmar po lcags kyu'i rnam pa can 'phros/ dbu ma'i nang nas yar song nas smin mtshams kyi thad nas 'thon/ ngag tu phaiṃzhes brjod cing mig gyen du bgrad de 'bar ba'i phyag rgyas smin mtshams kyi thad du lan gsum g.yon du bskor bas/

'og min na bzhugs pa'i lhan skyes kyi rdo rje rnal 'byor ma dang*/ yul nyer bzhi na bzhugs pa'i zhing skyes dang 'gro ba thams cad rdo rje rnal 'byor mar gyur pa sngags las skyes pa rnams steng nas char babs pa dang*/ 'og nas sa rlangs rdol ba dang*/ bar nas dge 'dun chos 'khor la 'tshogs pa lta bur byung nas rang nyid rnal 'byor mar gsal ba'i spyi bo nas thim par gyur/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ bdag nyid thabs shes gnyis su med pa la gnas pa bzhin du 'gro ba thams cad kyang thabs shes gnyis su med pa la gnas par bsam/ oṃ yo ga shud+dha sogs brjod/ lte ba la sogs pa'i gnas rnams dang*/ lag pa gnyis/ mkhrig ma gnyis/ dpung pa gnyis/ dpung mgo gnyis te tshigs chen brgyad dang bcas pa rnams la go cha'i sngags rnams gsal 'debs pa ni sgrub thabs kyi nang bzhin no// dgu pa bzlas pa'i rnal 'byor la gnyis las dang po ngag bzlas ni/ dbus kyi bam̐ yig gi ngo bo rnal 'byor ma'i thugs kar chos 'byung nyis brtsegs/ de'i steng du zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su bam̐ yig gi mthar g.yon skor du sngags phreng gis bskor bar bsam ste de rnams las 'od zer 'phros/ sems can thams cad kyi sdig sgrib sbyangs/ sangs rgyas thams cad mchod/ pho nya gsum byin rlabs kyis byin gyis brlab pa dang*/ mkha' spyod kyi dngos grub thams cad 'od zer dmar po'i rnam par byung nas bam̐ yig sngags phreng dang bcas pa la thim pas rgyud byin gyis brlabs par bsams la/ sngags mang nyung ji ltar rigs pa bzla/ de yang sems g.yengs pas bzlas pa la phan yon cher med pas/ gang bzla ba'i sgang la sgo gsum 'jug pa gcig tu dril nas bzlas na phan yon shin tu che ba yin te/ de skad du yang*/ bde mchog sdom 'byung las/ gzhan du mi 'gro'i sems kyis ni// de lta'i tshul gyis bzlas pa bya// yul gzhan blo ni 'gro ba yis// bskal par bzlas kyang 'bras mi 'byin// zhes gsungs so// yid bzlas ni/

gnas der thal 'tshubs med cing lto 'grangs ltogs snyoms pa'i dus su rlung ro rnams lan dgu phrugs su bus pa'i rjes su 'og rlung snyan gsan 'bebs pa'i tshul du 'then tsam bya/ steng rlung lus gug byas nas dal bus rngubs/ rlung rdzogs rjes mchil ma'i rta dang bcas te lte bar sdigs te bskyur/ de'i rkyen gyis snying ga'i chos 'byung zla ba sngags phreng bam̐ yig dang bcas pa lte bar slebs/ de nas 'og rlung rdzogs par 'then la rlung bum pa can bzung ste/ sngags rab bdun nam tha na'ang gsum la sogs pa yid kyis bzla/ 'dir zhar byung gi rdzogs rim ni snying ga'i chos 'byung la zur drug yod pa las mdun rgyab gnyis spangs pa'i grwa bzhir dga' ba 'khyil pa re re g.yon skor du 'khor bar bsams la rlung 'dzin pa'am yang na brjod med kyi ngang la bzhag yang gsang gnas nas yar rtsa dbu ma kha dgo dmar gsal sba lcag tsam mam mda' smyug 'bring po'i tshad tsam pa zhig rtse mo spyi bo nas mdun la gug nas smin mtshams su zug pa/ rtsa ba gsang gnas su zug pa/ dbu ma'i yas snar dga' ba 'khyil pa kha dog dkar po nas 'bras tsam pa g.yon skor du 'khor zhing yod pa de dbu ma'i nang nas mar g.yon du 'khor gyin byung bas snang ba thams cad bde cham cham song*/ dga' ba 'khyil pa de nyid mthar snying gar slebs/ yang dbu ma'i mas snar dga' ba 'khyil pa dmar po g.yon skor du 'khor zhing yod pa de dbu ma'i nang nas yar 'khor gyin byung bas snang ba thams cad stong cham cham song*/ de nyid kyang snying gar slebs nas dga' 'khyil gnyis gcig tu phrug chil te 'dres pas/ bde stong zung 'jug gi ngang la dga' 'khyil dkar dmar de nyid g.yon du 'khor ba/ mthar je yal je yal la song ste dbu ma stong pa dang gnyis su med par bsam mo// bcu pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i rnal 'byor la gnyis las/ thun mong ba ni sgrub thabs kyi nang bzhin/

thun mong ma yin pa ni zhal las shes so// bcu gcig pa spyod lam gyi rnal 'byor ni/ spyod lam dngos dang*/ de'i yan lag gnyis las/ dang po ni/ thun mtshams rnams su rang nyid rdo rje rnal 'byor ma rgyan dang phyag mtshan spangs pa/ snang ba thams cad kyang rnal 'byor ma de lta bu'i rnam pa can du gsal ba de'i ngo bo gang du'ang ma grub pa'i stong pa nyid de/ snang stong zung 'jug gi ngang du skyong ngo*// yang rgyob sod la sogs pa'i sgra thams cad la 'jigs snang dang log lta mi byed par oṃ gsum ma'i sgrar bsgom zhing de yang grags stong skye 'gag dang bral ba'i ngang du bskyangs/ dran rtog yid la rgyu ba thams cad la yang de'i rjes mi dpyod par de'i ngo bo la cher bltas pas gang du'ang ma grub pa'i stong nyid de'i ngang la bskyang*/ dper na zhe sdang lta bu gcig lhang gis skyes pa'i tshe/ de'i ngo bo la cher bltas pas gang du'ang ma grub pa'i stong nyid du thim pa'i tshe/ zhe sdang rang dag la 'gro ba bzhin no// nyams len 'di ni rgyun du ma brjed pa gal che ste/ mnyam gzhag tu thugs dam mog mog re byas nas rjes thob kun tu tha mal du lus na chos pa'i 'khyer so stor nas 'gro gsungs so// gnyis pa yan lag la bza' ba'i rnal 'byor/ phyi rol mchod pa/ sbyin sreg tshes bcu'i mchod pa/ gtor ma'o// dang po ni/ kha zas rnams 'bru gsum gyis brlabs la/ lag pa gnyis dgang gzar dang dgang blugs/ kha hom khung*/ kha zas bsreg rdzas kyi tshul du byas/ lte ba nas me 'bar bas zas kyi snyigs ma rnams tshig dwangs ma rnams snying gar bzhugs pa'i bla ma dang yi dam lha tshogs rnams kyi zhal du sib sib song bar bsam/ de ltar ma byung na byin gyis brlabs pa'i zas de/ rang rnal 'byor mar gsal ba'i zhal du gsol bas/ zas kyi dwangs ma thams cad snying ga'i bam̐ yig la sib sib thim pas bde chen gyi ye shes brnyes par bsam/

de ltar yang ma byung na byin gyis brlabs pa'i zas rnams kham re re nas rnal 'byor mar gsal ba de/ rang nyid rnal 'byor mar gsal ba'i zhal du lha la lha thim pa'i tshul du zos pas kha zas bu lon can du 'gyur ba'i nyes pa las grol lo// gnyis pa ni/ grong pa'i chos kyis ma gos pa'i bu mo gzhon nu ma bco lnga'am/ bcu gcig gam/ lnga'am gsum las mi nyung ba bsags nas ston mo bzang po bshams te/ de rnams rnal 'byor mar bskyed la mchod pa dang bstod pa dpe na gsal ba ltar byed/ 'di ni tshogs myur du rdzogs pa'i thabs yin no// gsum pa ni/ sbyin sreg rgyas bsdus ci rigs pa dpe na gsal ba ltar byed/ bzhi pa ni/ tshogs rdzogs pa'i ched du yar ngo dang*/ sgrib pa sbyang ba'i ched du mar ngo'i tshes bcu la sku tshom bu'i dkyil 'khor/ gsung bdud rtsi'i dkyil 'khor/ thugs sin+dhu ra'i dkyil 'khor rnams bzhengs/ de dag gi mdun du mchod pa dang gtor ma rnams lag len ltar bshams la/ sgrub cing mchod pa dang*/ bdag nyid 'jug cing dbang blang ba rnams bya'o// de ltar ma byung na tsan+dan dmar po btab pa'i chang gi khu bas maṇ+ḍal lam rdo leb bam shing leb ji ltar rigs pa la chos 'byung nyis brtsegs bam̐ yig dang bcas pas bris la sgrub mchod rkyang pa bya/ de ltar yang ma byung na rang gis rgyun du sngags ji tsam bzlas pa'i grangs de sum 'gyur du bzlas pas kyang tshes bcu'i mchod pa'i go chod par gsungs so// lnga pa gtor ma ni sgrub thabs na ji ltar gsal ba ltar rgyun du bya'o// de ltar rnal 'byor bcu gcig gi nyams len dang tshes bcu gnyis kyi mchod pa la brtson par byas pas/ dbang po rab la rdo rje rnal 'byor ma tha mal bud med kyi gzugs kyis mdun du byung ba de ngo shes nas gsol ba btab pas dus de nyid du mkha' spyod du 'khrid par byed do// 'di ni rab bzlas bsgom rkyang pa la brten nas mkha' spyod sgrub pa zhes bya ba yin no// dbang po 'bring la de dag gi steng du sngags 'bru 'bum gsum tsam dang*/

sgrub mchod dang sbrel nas sngags 'bum tsho bzhi tsam sgrub bsnyen gyi tshul du byas/ de yang sin+dhu ra 'bol po yod na thun re re la sbos la pa ru'i nang du sbog 'bol po med na thun gsum mam bzhi song nas ye shes pa gshegs gsol byas la gsar pa spo/ sgrub bsnyen grol nas sin+dhu ra rnams bal por skyes pa'i shing lang ka ling ka'am/ de ma 'byor na bod 'dir skyes pa'i shing do rgod pa tsam la/ de'i rkang la gad bdar byas te/ spos dang gu gul gyi dud pas bdug de'i sbubs stong gi nang du sin+dhu ra rnams blugs la/ dga' 'khyil bris pa'i pa ru chung ngus kha bcad/ mi 'dzag par bya ba'i phyir shog bu'am ras kyis pa ru'i phyi la g.yogs/ yar ngo'i tshes bcu'i dgong mo grogs bde mchog gi gzhi bsnyen song ba'i dam tshig can dang bsdebs la rnal 'byor bas dbyug pa gcig kyang khur nas dur khrod du phyin la der dong gru gsum brus nas/ de'i nang du sngar gyi sin+dhu ra snod dang bcas pa bcug la rgyus med kyis mi rig par byas/ de'i khar bsdad nas bdag bskyed bzlas pa byed/ 'khris su bar chad bsrung ba'i phyir grogs des rnal 'byor dbyug pa bzung nas sum+bha ni 'dren cing yun srod thun tsam du bsdad/ de nas nang du log nas sgrub mchod bzlas pa sogs thugs dam la brtson par byed/ sang nyin dgong mo nas bzung ste snga ma snga ma las rgyun ring bar sdod/ nyi shu'i dgong mo nam ma langs tshod du sdod/ nyer lnga'i tshe skya rengs nam shar gyi bar du sdod/ de nas rang nyid rnal 'byor pa'i chas su zhugs/ 'jig rten blos btang ste/ dpral bar sin+dhu ra de nyid kyis dga' ba 'khyil pa bris te lag tu rnal 'byor dbyug pa thogs te bud med mang po yod pa'i gnas kun tu nyul bas/ bud med gang rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i sprul pa yin pa de'i dpral bar sin+dhu ra'i dga' ba 'khyil pa/

me long gi nang gi gzugs brnyan shar ba bzhin 'phos yong ba yin pa de nam byung ba dang*/ bud med de la g.yon nas bskor ba byas la gsol ba btab pas dus de nyid du mkha' spyod du 'khrid par byed do// 'di ni 'bring las sbyor dang bzlas bsgom la brten nas mkha' spyod sgrub pa zhes bya ba yin no// de ltar lag len ma thub pa'am dbang po tha mas de ltar byas kyang mkha' spyod ma 'grub na/ sgyid lug pa spangs te/ rgyun du bzlas bsgom la brtson par bya zhing nam zhig 'chi ltas byung ba'i tshe/ sngar bla mas bstan pa'i 'pho ba'i gdams pa nyams su blangs pas tshe 'di'am/ bar do'am tha na'ang skye ba brgyud nas mkha' spyod 'grub pa yin gsungs so// de ltar na sngar bshad pa de dag gi gtso bor bsgom bya'i don la thos bsam gyis sgro 'dogs bcad nas dpyad don nyams su blang ba sems 'dzin gyi khrid la/ bskyed rdzogs gnyis las/ dang po ni/ snying gar e las chos 'byung nyis brtsegs bskyed pa nas bzung shud+dho3haṃ gi bar/ rnam rtog gzhan gyis bar ma chod par byas la de'i rjes su nga ni spangs rtogs kun rdzogs pa'i bcom ldan 'das rdo rje rnal 'byor ma dngos yin no snyam du nga rgyal la sems 'dzin/ yin tshul rgyan cha lugs zhal phyag gi rnam pa can 'di lta bu yin no snyam du rnam pa spyi la sems 'dzin/ rnam pa bye brag pa la rgyan med dang*/ rgyan bcas gnyis las dang po ni/ spyan dbus ma dbus nag pa mtha' skya ba spyan rtsa dmar shi ge ba g.yas phyogs su rdzi ma dang bcas pa la sems 'dzin/ de yang gsal po byung ba'i tshe de la zhen nas bsdad na myur du rnam rtog gi rkun pos 'phrog 'gro/ gsal po ma byung ba'i tshe gsal po yong la re bas bsdad na sems dang dmigs pa 'gras nas phyis sgom skye ba'i gegs byed pas gsal na gsal te 'phro bcad/ mi gsal na mi gsal te 'phro bcad do// yang yang bsgoms kyang gsal po ma byung na/

spyan dbus ma shog bu la bris pa mdun du mthong sar bzhag la 'di lta bu cig smin mtshams na yod snyam pa byas nas sems 'dzin/ mdor na spyan dbus ma la gsal snang ma skyes kyi bar du bsgom/ spyan g.yas g.yon gnyis la yang de ltar du sems 'dzin/ de nas shangs byi ru'i mdog ltar dmar ba snyan shal ring ba/ mchu sgros rnams legs pa/ zhal he zer ba lta bu'i nang na tshems bzhi bcu tham pa dung ltar dkar la thags bzang ba/ zur bzhir mche ba'i myu gu nas smyug tsam gtsigs pa/ mgrin pa ol gnyer rim pa phyed gsum tsam byas pa nas bzung ste me ri'i bar gyi rgyan med dang rgyan bcas rnams la'ang rim pa bzhin du sems 'dzin/ de yang res me ri nas spyan dbus ma'i bar la yang rim pa bzhin/ res spyan dbus ma nas me ri'i bar la mar rim pa bzhin sems 'dzin no// gnyis pa rdzogs rim ni/ spyir rdzogs rim rgyas pa zhes bya ba/ slob dpon nag po spyod pa'i rdo rjes bkral ba/ rgya gar skad du/ o la pa ti/ bod skad du/ rim pa bzhi pa dang*/ 'bring po slob dpon dril bu pas rdo rje rnal 'byor ma las dngos su gsan pa dril bu rim lnga byin rlabs dang bcas pa dang*/ bsdus pa lo hi pas shā ba ri dbang phyug las gsan pa'i rdzogs rim bsdus pa gsum dang*/ rtsa dbu ma'i khrid dang*/ bde mchog dkar po'i khrid rnams zab cing rgya che ba rnams bzhugs kyang*/ de dag las kyang nā ro pas rdo rje rnal 'byor ma las dngos su gsan pa'i rtsa dbu ma'i khrid ces bya ba 'di zab la/ de la chos nyid dngos su ston pa'i lam dang*/ brgyud nas ston pa'i lam gnyis las/ dang po ni rgya mtsho chen po blta bar 'dod pa'i mi zhig la rgya mtsho ni gting zab pa kha dog sngo ba rba rlabs g.yo ba/ nya dang chu srin la sogs pa srog chags mang pos yongs su gang ba'o// zhes brjod kyang 'ol spyi tsam las mi 'char la/ dpe de bzhin du bla mas maṇ+ḍal gyi steng gi dkar gong sogs kyi brda thabs la brten nas/

chos nyid dngos su bstan kyang don spyi tsam las mi 'char bas/ de las chos nyid brgyud nas ston pa'i lam 'di zab ste/ rgya mtsho chen po blta bar 'dod pa la/ lam 'di dang 'di zhes bya bar brgyud nas phyin na rgya mtsho mthong ngo zhes brjod pas des kyang ji skad zer ba'i lam la zhugs nas phyin pas rgya mtshor slebs pa na/ ji ltar 'dug pa'i sgro 'dogs rnams chod yong*/ dpe de bzhin du bskyed rdzogs kyi gdams pa 'di rnams nyams su blangs pas/ mtshon byed dpe yi ye shes myur du skye zhing de la brten nas mtshon bya don gyi ye shes myur du skye bas so// de yang dpe gsum gyis don gtan la 'bebs pa ste/ bshan pa srog gi gnad la mkhas pa/ shing mkhan shing gi gnad la mkhas pa/ sgyu ma mkhan 'khrul 'khor gyi gnad la mkhas pa dang gsum las/ dang po ni/ mi mang pos gros byas nas sems can gcig gsod pa'i tshe/ lag pa dang rkang pa sogs bcad kyang yun ring po'i bar du mi 'chi/ bshan pa srog gi gnad shes pa gcig gis srog gi rten gang du gnas der/ snyung bu lta bu'i mtshon chung ngu gcig brgyab pas de ma thag tu 'chi/ gnyis pa ni rgya gar ḍā ki nī pa ta zhes bya ba'i grong khyer na/ shing sdong po chen po zhig yod pa la/ mon pa s+t+wa re thogs pa brgya phrag du ma 'tshogs nas sdong po de'i yal ga sogs bcad pa na/ phyogs gcig nas bcad kyang phyogs gcig nas grub pas rtsa ba nas gcod mi thub/ shing mkhan mkhas pa gcig gis chu rgyu ba'i gnas gang na 'dug btsal nas der bu gu chung ngu zhig phug ste lcags kyi gzer rgyab pas rtsa ba nas myur du 'gyel 'gro'o// gsum pa ni rgyal po bho dzā ha ra zhes bya ba'i yul na grong khyer chen po bzhi yod pa/ sgo rnams srung mkhan shing gi mi rig 'khrul 'khor gyi ral gri thogs pa du mas rgyun du bskor bas thabs gang byas kyang der sus kyang 'jug mi thub/

'khrul 'khor gyi gnad shes pa gcig gis skud pa chung ngu gcig bcad pas 'khrul 'khor zhig ste/ de bde blag tu 'jug thub/ dpe de rnams bzhin du gnad dang mi ldan pa'i gdams ngag mang po nyams su blangs pas/ dbu ma'i nang du rlung sems 'jug mi nus/ gnad dang ldan pa'i gdams ngag chung ngu zhig nyams su blangs pas kyang dbu ma'i nang du rlung sems zhugs te myur du bde chen gyi ye shes skye ba yin no// des na gnad dang ldan pa'i gdams pa 'di 'chad pa la/ rgyu chos can 'khor ba'i gnad/ lam bsgoms pa'i gnad/ 'bras bu sangs rgyas pa'i gnad dang gsum las/ dang po ni/ 'chi 'pho ba'i tshe/ tshe 'di'i snang ba 'gags te rang bzhin brgyad cu'i rtog pa thams cad dbyings su nub nas 'chi ba 'od gsal chos sku 'char/ de'i tshe sngar nas goms 'dris med pas lhan skyes kyi ma rig pas bslad de 'od gsal ngo mi 'phrod/ de las langs nas bar do'i snang ba rnams 'char zhing*/ der 'khrul snang gi sdug bsngal mang pos gdungs pa'i tshe/ skye srid 'tshol 'dod kyi snang ba 'char la/ skye ba len pa'i tshe mi'i mngal thag ring po na yod kyang las kyi mig gis mthong nas der 'gro la/ de yang mir skye ba len na phor skye rgyu de ma la chags shing pha la sdang*/ mor skye rgyu de pha la chags shing ma la sdang sems skye zhing*/ pha las thob pa'i khams gsum dang ma las thob pa'i khams gsum ste/ khams drug dang bcas te skye srid du nying mtshams sbyor/ de'i tshe gnyis snang thams cad nub pa'i 'od gsal 'char yang*/ lhan skyes kyi ma rig pas bslad pa la brten nas ngo ma shes pas zhag bdun gyi bar du brgyal pa ltar 'gyur/ de nas chos thams cad zung 'jug tu 'dug snyam nas zung 'jug la 'dzin pa zhugs pa las/ dbus drang po nas yar rtsa dbu ma rta lnga brgyar gshags pa'i tshad tsam pa cig grub yang stong pa la 'dzin pa zhugs pa las g.yas na ro ma tshad de tsam pa cig grub/

yang gsal ba la 'dzin pa zhugs pa las g.yon na yar rkyang ma tshad de tsam pa cig grub/ de nas pho brang lnga la sogs pa'i lus rnams rim gyis grub ste zla ba dgu song bas btsa' ba'i dus la babs pa'i tshe/ sna sgor las kyi rlung gcig sir byung ba'i rkyen gyis khams dkar dmar gnyis ka gyes te lus po mgo 'jug log nas skye/ de nas ro rkyang las gyes pa'i rtsa phreng ji snyed pa rnams su rlung sems kyi 'gro 'ong byas pa las/ gzung 'dzin gnyis snang gi rtog pa 'ba' zhig 'char ro// de bas na gnyis med dam bde chen gyi ye shes skye ba'i thabs ni/ rgyud las/ pho nya mchog 'bring tha ma rnams// zhes gsungs pa ste/ rgyal po'i bya ba shin tu myur ba dang*/ myur ba tsam dang*/ yun ring mo zhig nas bsgrub pa'i dbang chen gsum la dbang chen rab 'bring tha ma gsum du 'jog pa ltar/ rtsa dbu ma'i nang du rlung sems zhugs na shin tu myur ba nyid du bde chen gyi ye shes skye/ pu dza o a la sogs pa'i yul nyer bzhi'i rtsa rnams su rlung sems zhugs na bde chen gyi ye shes myur ba tsam du skye/ ba spu bye ba phrag phyed dang bzhir grangs mnyam pa'i rtsa rnams su rlung sems zhugs na yun ring mo nas bde chen gyi ye shes rgyud la skye bas na/ rim bzhin pho nya mchog 'bring tha ma rnams su 'jog pa las/ 'dir dbu ma'i kha 'byed pa la brtson par bya ste/ mtshan brjod las/ ma rig sgo nga'i sbubs byed pa// zhes gsungs pa yang dbu ma'i kha 'byed pa la dgongs so// gnyis pa lam bsgoms pa'i gnad la/ chags can pho nya'i lam la dga' ba dang*/ chags bral rnal 'byor pa'i lam la dga' ba gnyis las/ 'dir phyi ma 'chad pa las dbu ma'i nang du rlung sems bsdu tshul dang*/ bsdus nas bsgom tshul gnyis las/ dang po ni rkang pa rdo rje skyil krung*/ lag pa gnyis mnyam bzhag la mthe bong lto sbyar/ sgal tshigs nyi shu rtsa gcig dong rtse ltar bsgrengs/

dpung pa gnyis rgod kyi gshog pa ltar brgyang*/ mig sna rtser phab/ mchu gnyis reg la ma 'byar bar bya/ ma nes o ko non tsam gyis lus gnad legs par bca' ste/ sa paṇa gyis/ lus kyi 'khrul 'khor rab bcing na// sems kyi dmigs pa rtse gcig 'grub// ces gsungs pa ltar/ ting nge 'dzin skye ba lus gnad rang gal che gsungs/ de yang lus drang na rtsa drang*/ rtsa drang na rlung drang*/ rlung drang na khams drang ste/ sems dmigs pa la rtse gcig tu gnas pa 'byung ngo*// de ltar lus gnad rnams bcos rjes gsang gnas nas bzung ste lus kyi dbus drang po na yar dbu ma sba lcag 'bring po tsam rtse mo smin mtshams su zug pa/ g.yas g.yon gnyis nas mar ro ma dang rkyang ma gnyis gro sog 'bring po'i tshad tsam pa re ya mtha' spyi bo tshangs pa'i bu ga thug par drang thal le song ba/ de nas tshur mdun la gug nas ro rkyang gnyis kyi rtse sna bug g.yas g.yon la ha re zug pa/ lte ba'i thad du rtsa de gsum sbubs gcig tu gyur pa'i sbubs stong gi nang du ram̐ dmar po ril ma tsam zhig gsal btab la/ rlung ro lan dgu phrugs su bus nas/ 'og rlung yar 'then tsam byas/ steng rlung dal bus rngubs la 'og sgo 'byed 'dzum lan gsum gyi sgo nas rlung rdzogs par 'then/ rlung bum can bzung bas lte ba'i ram̐ las me dmar hur hur 'bar bar bsams la/ de'i ngang la 'dzin med du 'jog de yang me 'bar ba ma bsgoms na drod mi skye/ 'dzin med du ma bzhag na mu stegs byed kyi gtum mo ltar bde chen gyi ye shes mi skye gsungs so// lte ba'i me de rnams ba spu bye ba phrag phyed bzhi dang grangs mnyam pa'i rtsa phran rnams kyi nang na yar zhugs pas khams snyigs ma thams cad tshig dwangs ma thams cad thur du babs nas lte ba'i rtsa sbubs stong ha re ba de thig le kha dog sngo skya'i rnam pa can gyi khams dwangs mas khreg mer te khengs par bsam/

gnyis pa bsdus nas bsgom tshul ni/ rlung lus la btsud pas bde ba bsgrub pa'i dmigs pa dang*/ rlung sems la btsud pas stong pa bsgrub pa'i dmigs pa gnyis las/ dang po ni smin mtshams su chos 'byung gru gsum rtsa ba phra ba dbu ma'i yas sna la zug pa/ gdengs kha che ba phyir bstan pa/ de'i gdengs kha che sa ru thig le kha dog lnga ldan/ kha dog lnga'i 'od zer rnams rang rang ma 'dres par so sor khra khrug pa la sems gtad de rlung bum pa can bzung*/ de ltar byas pas smin mtshams su na lhang ba'am grang lhang lhang ba'i rtags byung na/ thig le de nyid spyi bo tshangs pa'i bu gar 'phos te/ de nyid re rtse'i skar ma bzhin 'od khrug khrug pa la sems gtad de rlung bum pa can bzung*/ de yang rtags de ltar byung ba na/ de las thig le dkar po shel dkar bzhu ba'i khu ba lta bu dar dkar gyi skud pa brkyangs pa ltar skya nar byung nas mgrin par sleb/ bde ba skyes par bsam ste de la sems gtad/ snying ga dang lte ba la yang de bzhin bya/ de nas rang rdo rje rnal 'byor mar gsal ba'i gsang gnas su chos 'byung gru gsum rtsa ba phra ba dbu ma'i mas sne ru zug pa/ gdengs kha che ba phyir bstan pa mig gu thal le yod pa'i nang las 'thon te/ mtshan ma pad+ma dmar po kha bye ba lta bu'i ze'u 'bru'i dbus na mar sor phyed gsum tsam phyir nyug ge yod pa la sems gtad de rlung bum pa can bzung*/ bde ba che drags na thig le 'dzag pa'i nyen yod pas/ sor phyed dam phyed dang gnyis sam/ gnyis ji ltar rigs pa bde ba che chung dang bstun nas yar nang du bsdus la lhag ma phyir nyug ge yod pa la sems gtad de rlung bum pa can bzung*/ gnyis pa ni/ smin mtshams su chos 'byung thig le bsgom pa dang thig le de spyi bor spos te rtags ma byung gi bar du bsgom pa rnams sngar ltar byas pa'i rjes la/ thig le de las 'od kha dog lnga ldan 'ja' 'od kyi rnam pa can spros te/

de phog pas lus rnams rim bzhin 'ja' 'od du gyur/ yang 'od kha dog lnga ldan gyi 'ja' 'od de phar rim bzhin spros pas/ gnas khang lung pa yul phyogs 'dzam bu gling stong gsum 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad dang mthar nam mkha'i mthas khyab tshad 'ja' 'od du gyur pa la sems gtad/ thun bsdu bar 'dod na 'ja' 'od thams cad rang yal du song ba'i stong nyid de'i ngang la 'dzin med du 'jog pa'am/ yang na phyi'i 'ja' 'od thams cad bsdus nas lus 'ja' 'od kyi rnam par gnas pa de la thim/ de yang bsdus nas spyi bo'i thig le la thim par bsams nas thig le de la sems gtad de 'dzin med du khral le 'jog de ltar yun ring bsgoms nas ri rtse lta bu rlung ngar che sa ru phyin la yang bsgoms pas rlung gi reg bya de bzod na de gar bsgom/ mi bzod na nang du log la bsgom/ de bzhin du nyi ma dang me'i tsha gdung che chung rnams la yang de ltar du sbyang*/ yang kun 'dar gsang spyod bya ba dur khrod lta bu'i gnyan sa ru phyin la bsgoms pas 'phar lhongs shing*/ tshur lha 'dre'i zer bzod mi bzod bltas la/ mi bzod na nang du log la bsgom/ bzod na de gar bsgom zhing de nas rim bzhin kun 'dar mngon spyod dang phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba'i spyod pa rnams kyang spyad nas mkha' 'gros lung bstan pa'i phyag rgya pad+ma can dang mnyam par sbyor ba'i nye rgyu la brten nas/ bcu gsum rdo rje 'dzin pa'i sa myur ba nyid du mngon du byas pa yin no// de ltar rje btsun rnal 'byor ma yum rkyang gi khrid rim 'di ni/ tsha lung dgon par rje bla ma dam pa mthu stobs kyi dbang phyug bsod nams chos 'phel gyi gsung la bka' 'bangs kyi tha chung ngag dbang gi zin ris su byas pa*// 'dis kyang rje bla ma dam pa'i bstan pa yul dus kun tu dar zhing rgyas par gyur cig sarba maṅga laṃ// ༈ /

rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i bsam mi khyab thun mong ma yin pa'i zhal shes kyi nyams len zab mo bzhugs so// ༈ /bla ma dang rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma dbyer ma mchis pa la phyag 'tshal lo// 'dir bsam mi khyab thun mong ma yin pa'i zhal shes ni/ rang rdo rje rnal 'byor mar gsal ba'i lte ba nas bzung ste lus kyi dbus drang po nas rtsa dbu ma sbom phra sba lcag tsam pa/ de'i g.yas na yar ro ma dmar mo/ g.yon na yar rkyang ma dkar po dang de gnyis mda' smyug 'bring po tsam gsum gshibs byas pa spyi bo'i bar du slebs nas tshur mdun la gug pas dbu ma'i rtse mo spyan dbus ma'i thad du zug pa/ gzhan gnyis kyi rtse mo sna g.yas g.yon gnyis la ha re zug pa/ dbu ma'i mas snar rang gi sems nyid kyi ngo bo rnal 'byor ma mtheb sor gyi tshad tsam pa dwangs gsal 'od kyi rang bzhin 'phar la khad pa de las de 'dra ba'i sku chung ngu gcig me stag ltar chad ro ma'i nang nas yar dmar khyug ste song nas sna bug g.yas kyi sgor sleb/ de las sku nas 'bras tsam pa la sogs pa nyi zer gyi rdul bas lhag pa tsam chad nas sangs rgyas thams cad la mnyes pa'i mchod pa 'bul/ sems can thams cad kyi sdig sgrib sbyangs nas rnal 'byor ma'i skur gyur/ rlung rngubs pa dang mnyam du tshur 'dus nas sna bug g.yas kyi sgo na yod pa'i rnal 'byor ma la thim/ de nyid sna bug g.yon gyi nang du song rkyang ma'i nang nas mar zhugs nas/ lte ba'i rdo rje rnal 'byor ma la thim/ 'di ni sbyang ba zhes bya ba yin pas/ lan bdun nam lnga gang rung bya/ lte ba'i rnal 'byor ma las 'od zer 'phros pas lus la phog yan lag thams cad 'od du zhu nas lus po ma la thim/ de 'od kyi gong bur gyur/ rnal 'byor ma de nyid mkha' spyod du rings pa'i tshul gyis nar tsam byon pas lte ba man chad kyi lus po sku de la thim/ ro rkyang gnyis kyi rtse mo zhabs mthil g.yas g.yon gnyis la thim/

dbu ma'i rtse mo spyi bo la thim/ snying gar byon pas de man chad kyi lus dang rtsa gsum sku la thim/ de bzhin du mgrin par byon pas kyang de ltar thim/ spyi bor byon pas lus po rtsa gsum po dang bcas pa thams cad sku la thim/ de nyid skar mda' 'phang ba'am rtsal chen gyis mda' 'phangs pa bzhin du blos 'khyud tshad kyi nam mkha'i mthongs su bskyal la 'dzin med du khral le 'jog slar yang bya nam mkha' nas bab pa bzhin bab ste/ lte ba'i gnas su sleb/ de tsam na lus dang rtsa thams cad kyang grub par bsam/ 'di la rdzong pa rnal 'byor ma'i 'pho chung zer/ ngor pa byin po rnams rnal 'byor ma'i 'chi chung zer/ gang ltar yang 'di nyid ni gdams pa 'di'i nyams len gyi snying po yin zhing 'pho ba yang 'di ga yin pas dus rgyun du nyams len 'di la gtso bor 'bad par rigs la/ 'di lus sems ya ma bral bar tshogs pa gcig tu 'dres nas 'pho ba yin pas 'pho rab tshe thung ba'i skyon yang med gsungs so// gdams pa 'di brjed na phongs kyis dogs nas rang gi brjed thor bris pa la bla ma dang mkha' 'gro'i tshogs kyis bzod par bzhes la/ rgyun du thugs rje chen pos bskyang du gsol/ rje bla ma dam pa bsod nams chos 'phel gyi gsung la/ bka' 'bangs kyi tha chung ngag dbang gis zin bris su byas pa*// ༈ / rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i 'pho ba'i zhal shes dang po yab la brten pa bzhugs so// ༈ /bla ma dang rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma dbyer ma mchis pa la phyag 'tshal lo// 'dir 'pho ba'i zhal shes dang po ni/ lte ba nas bzung ste spyi bo tshangs pa'i bu ga'i bar la rtsa dbu ma drang thal ler song ba'i yas sna tshangs pa'i bu ga dang mnyam pa rgya mthongs kha phye ba lta bu/ sbom phra rtsa ba sba lcag 'bring po tsam/ de nas yar rim pa bzhin du je sbom du song ba'i spyi gtsug gi steng gi nam mkhar pad+ma dang zla ba dang 'jigs byed dus mtshan dang bcas pa'i steng du/

rtsa ba'i bla ma bde mchog lhan skyes sku mdog sngon po zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyis rdo rje dang dril bu thugs kar bsnol nas 'dzin pa/ yum rdo rje phag mo dang mnyam par sbyor ba/ mtha' bskor kun tu mkha' spyod kyi dpa' bo dang dpa' mo rnams kyis sprin gtibs pa bzhin du bskor ba/ phyogs bcu'i bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas byang sems mkha' 'gro chos srung thams cad spyan drangs nas bla ma yab yum la bstims pas skyabs gnas kun 'dus kyi ngo bor gyur par bsam/ lte ba'i thad kyi dbu ma'i mas sna ru nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor chung ngu 'khyil pa gcig bsam/ de'i steng du rang sems kyi ngo bo rnal 'byor ma dwangs gsal 'od kyi rang bzhin mtheb sor gyi tshad tsam pa 'phur la khad 'phur la khad cig bsams la/ spyi bo'i bla ma la mos gus rtse gcig pa'i sgo nas/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ngo bo dpal ldan bla ma dam pa la gsol ba 'debs so// bdag 'dzin blo yis thong bar byin gyis rlobs// dgos med rgyud la skye bar byin gyis rlobs/ lam mchog 'pho ba 'byongs par byin gyis rlobs// 'phyugs med mkha' spyod 'grub par byin gyis rlobs// zhes gsol ba btab la/ 'og sgo 'then tsam byas pas rlung gis nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor phul/ de'i rkyen gyis rang sems kyi ngo bor gyur pa'i rdo rje rnal 'byor ma de rgya mthongs las bya 'phur ba bzhin du dbu ma'i nang nas yar song*/ spyi gtsug nas 'thon te/ bla ma yab yum gyi thugs kar thim par bsams la 'dzin med du khral le 'jog steng rlung mnan pas bla ma yab yum gyi thugs ka nas rgyangs 'thon nas dbu ma'i mas sne nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du sleb/ yang gsol ba 'debs pa sogs sngar ltar byas la/ bla ma yab yum gyi thugs kar 'pho/ grangs mang nyung ni khrid kyi dus su thun res lan grangs bdun tsam re bya/ sbyang ba'i dus su zhag bdun tsam mtshams bcad la grangs bcad dang thun grangs med par sbyangs pas/

'byongs ba'i rtags ni spyi gtsug skrangs pa dang khrag thon pa dang*/ sgrub khang la 'ja' zug pa dang*/ me tog gi char bab pa rnams yin gsungs/ des na nyams len 'di ni khyi bdun gyis dus gcig tu ded kyang mi brjed pa gcig dgos te/ gzhan du na nam zhig las la sbyor ba'i tshe na nyams su longs pa dka'o// thun de las ldang ba na/ mtha' skor gyi dpa' bo dang dpa' mo thams cad 'od du zhu nas bla ma yab yum gnyis la thim/ bla ma yab yum gnyis kyang spyi gtsug nas mar snying khar byon/ spyi gtsug rgya mthongs kha bye pa lta bu de 'od dmar po las grub pa'i sna tshogs rdo rje zhig gis bkab pas steng nas chu yang mi 'dzag 'og nas rlung yang mi thar bar bsam/ snying ga'i bla ma yab yum dang lte ba'i rdo rje rnal 'byor ma yar mar gzigs res kyis bde ba sgrub pa'i dmigs pa ci rigs pa bya/ 'di dus rgyun du ni mi bya ste/ 'pho rab tshe thung bya ba yin// las la sbyar ba ni/ nam zhig nye ba'i 'chi ltas byung ba'i tshe/ spong dag dang tshe bsgrub byas la/ ltas log gam ma log blta/ ma log pa na 'pho ba'i nyams len bya ste/ de yang rang sems kyi ngo bor gyur pa'i rdo rje rnal 'byor ma de bla ma yab yum gyi thugs kar 'phos la de'i ngang las bla ma yab yum mkha' spyod du gshegs par bsam/ dbugs kyi rgyu ba ma chad kyi bar la yang dang yang du bya/ 'pho ba gnad du song na bar do med par mkha' spyod 'grub pa yin no// // ༈ / rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i 'pho ba'i zhal shes gnyis pa yum la brten pa bzhugs so// ༈ /zhal shes gnyis pa ni/ lte ba nas bzung ste/ spyi bo tshangs pa'i bu ga'i bar du dbu ma drang thal ler song ba'i rtsa ba sba lcag 'bring po tsam pa/ de nas yar rim pa bzhin du je sbom du song ba'i rtse mo tshangs pa'i bu ga dang mnyam du rgya mthongs kha phye ba lta bu ha re yod pa/ de'i steng du sna tshogs pad+ma zla ba 'jigs byed dus mtshan dang bcas pa'i gdan gyi steng du rtsa ba'i bla ma rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma zhal phyag rgyan cha lugs yongs su rdzogs pa/

mtha' skor kun tu mkha' spyod kyi dpa' bo dang dpa' mo rnams kyis sprin gtibs pa tsam du bskor bar bsam/ de nas phyogs bcu'i bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas byang sems thams cad spyan drangs nas bla ma la bstim pas/ bla ma de nyid skyabs gnas kun 'dus pa'i ngo bor gyur par bsam mo// rang gi lte ba'i thad kyi dbu ma'i mas sna ru chos 'byung gru gsum rtsa ba phra ba gsang gnas su zug pa/ gdengs kha che ba gyen du bstan pa/ de'i nang du rang sems kyi ngo bo bam̐ yig ril ma tsam zhig bsam/ rang gi lus longs spyod la sogs pa'i dngos po ci yod pa thams cad bla ma la mchod pa'i yo byad du 'bul snyam pa'i sgo nas/ oṃ badz+ra yo gi nī sa pā ri wā ra ar+ghṃ sogs kyis mchod pa phyag rgya dang bcas pas mchod cing*/ dpal ldan rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma sogs kyi bstod pa dang*/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ngo bo dpal ldan bla ma dam pa la gsol ba 'debs so sogs sngar ltar byas la/ rang sems kyi ngo bo bam̐ yig de dbu ma'i nang nas yar rgya mthongs las bya 'phur pa bzhin song nas bla ma'i thugs kar thim/ de'i ngang la 'dzin med du khral ler 'jog yang bla ma'i thugs ka nas 'thon te/ dbu ma'i mas sna'i chos 'byung gi steng du sleb/ yang sngar ltar mchod bstod gsol 'debs byas pas bla ma'i thugs kar 'pho/ las sbyor gyi tshe gong dang 'dra'o// khrid kyi dus su gnyis ka la thun ma chag pa byed dgos/ de nas rang gang la mos pa zhig la chig dril byas te tshul bzhin nyams su blangs nas mkha' spyod 'grub par 'gyur ro// des ni tshe nyi zla dang mnyam pa dang*/ longs spyod nam mkha'i mdzod la dbang 'byor pa/ rdo rje rnal 'byor mas chos dngos su ston cing de'i byin gyis rlabs pa la brten nas/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing khams rnams kyang bgrod nus pa yin gsungs so// de ltar 'pho ba'i gdams pa gnyis po 'di ni/

rje btsun bla ma dam pa rig sngags 'chang ba chen po bsod nams chos 'phel gyi gsung la/ de nyid kyi zhabs rdul spyi bos len pa ngag dbang gis zin bris su byas pa'o// ༈ /dhi/ rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma nā ro mkha' spyod kyi bla ma'i rnal 'byor thun mong ma yin pa'i yig chung bzhugs so// ༈ /gnyis pa dpyad don nyams su blang ba la/ mdun gyi nam mkhar dag gsal gnyis su med pa'i ye shes kyi snang ba las grub pa'i gzhal yas khang gru bzhi sgo bzhi rgyan rta babs dang bcas pa mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa'i dbus su/ seṅge chen po brgyad kyis bteg pa'i rin po che'i khri/ sna tshogs pad+ma dang zla ba nyi ma'i gdan gyi steng du/ drin chen rtsa ba'i bla ma de nyid sangs rgyas rdo rje chos kyi rnam pa can sku mdog dmar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyis rdo rje dang dril bu thugs kar bsnol nas 'dzin pa/ dbu skra ral pa'i cod pan can/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa/ gzhon nu lang tsho bcu drug lon pa'i na tshod can/ dar dang rus pa dang rin po che'i rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ de'i mtha' skor du sangs rgyas rdo rje 'chang la sogs te brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams mu tig bstar la brgyus pa ltar g.yas skor gyi tshul gyis bzhugs pa/ de thams cad dpa' bo rdo rje chos kyi rnam pas dkyus bzhin bskyed/ gtso 'khor de thams cad kyi dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥthugs kar hūm̐/ thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas/ rang bzhin gyi gnas nas brgyud pa'i bla ma/ yi dam dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs/ sangs rgyas byang sems dpa' bo mkha' 'gro/ chos skyong srung ma'i tshogs dang bcas pa oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ skyabs gnas re re'ang skyabs gnas kun 'dus kyi ngo bor gyur/ gang gi drin gyis sh+lau ka gcig brgyud pa'i bla ma'i gsol 'debs kyi rjes su/

rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams la gsol ba 'debs so// khyed rnams kyis bdag gi rgyud byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes pa tshar gsum/ de nas phyi nang gsang ba de kho na nyid kyi mchod pa byas rjes/ rang gi snying ga nas rang sems kyi ngo bo rdo rje rnal 'byor ma mtheb sor tshad tsam zhig lus kyi dbus drang por rtsa dbu ma'i lam nas brgyud spyi bo tshangs pa'i bu ga nas rgyangs te 'thon/ des gzigs pas lus tsho zhing snum pa che zhing brjid pa khrang nge gnas pa de'i rtsar byon/ phyag g.yas kyi gri gug gis rang gi lus kyi thod pa ling gis bkog mdun du thod pa'i sgyed pu ri rab tsam gsum grub pa'i steng du bkal te/ de la cher gzigs pas de je cher song ste/ mthar stong gsum gyi khyon dang mnyam par gyur/ de nas rkang pa g.yon dum bu gsum du bcad nas thod pa'i nang du bskyur/ de bzhin du lus thams cad bcad nas bskyur bas/ sha'i phung po/ rak+ta'i rgya mtsho/ rus pa'i gram khrod chen por gyur pa la thugs gtad/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha hoḥhrīḥlan gsum brjod pas bdud rtsi kha dog dkar ba/ ro mngar ba/ reg bya bsil ba/ nus pa phun sum tshogs pa dang ldan par bsam/ snying ga nas mchod pa'i lha mo thod pa thogs pa dpag tu med pa spros/ de rnams kyis thod pa'i bdud rtsi nas bcus te rtsa ba'i bla ma la lan gsum/ brgyud pa'i bla ma la re re/ de bzhin du skyabs gnas gzhan rnams la yang 'bul/ mthar mchod pa'i lha mo rnams kyis rigs drug gi sems can rnams la bdud rtsi byin pas/ de dag gis bdud rtsi de mthong ba thos pa reg pa tsam gyis thams cad kyi sdig sgrib bag chags dang bcas pa dag ste/ sems rtog med chos kyi sku dang*/ lus zag med rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i skur gyur par bsam/ mchod pa'i lha mo rnams rang gi snying gar bsdu/ thod pa'i sgyed pu gsum dang bcas pa nam mkha' la 'ja' yal pa ltar bsam/

khrid kyi dus skabs 'dir maṇ+ḍal mdzad/ slar rtsa ba'i bla ma la dmigs te/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ngo bo/ dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams la gsol ba 'debs so// bdag la dbang bzhi rdzogs par bskur du gsol/ zhes lan gsum gsol ba btab pas/ rtsa ba'i bla mas brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams la spyan 'khor re gzigs te dbang bzhi bskur mi bskur gyi gnang ba zhus pas brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams kyis rtsa ba'i bla ma la spyan cher gzigs nas de de bzhin du bgyis zhes gnang ba byin par bsams nas/ bla ma'i spyi bo'i oṃ las 'od zer dkar po byung ba sogs dbang bzhi blang*/ mthar yid kyis phur tshugs su gsol ba btab pas/ spyan 'gros kyis mas rim bzhin thim/ mthar rdo rje 'chang yang rtsa ba'i bla ma la thim/ de bzhin gzhal yas khang 'od du zhu nas seng khri pad nyi zla ba dang bcas pa la thim/ de dag rtsa ba'i bla ma la thim ste/ bla ma skyabs gnas kun 'dus su gyur/ 'dom gang nam mkha' la 'od du zhu la khad/ dmar ser li khri'i mdog ltar spyi gtsug thim/ bam̐/ gnas/ je cher/ lus stong gsum/ yal ba'i chos nyid ngang las e las/ snying gi dkyil las gzhan ma lags// dus gsum rgyal ba sras bcas kyi// thugs rje gcig char 'jug byed pa// zab lam bla ma'i man ngag 'di// snying gi dbus su gces par bzung*// ༈ /

nā ro mkha' spyod kyi bla ma'i rnal 'byor dang mkha' spyod sgrub pa'i zhal shes yig chung bzhugs so// ༈ /na mo badz+ra yo gi nī ye/ rje btsun nā ro ta pa'i lugs kyi nā ro mkha' spyod ma'i sgrub thabs la/ zhal nas brgyud pa'i man ngag gsum/ dang po tshogs zhing gi skabs su/ mdun du rtsa ba'i bla ma gsung rdo rje'i rnam pa can/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pa la/ brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams dmar po ḍā ma ru dang*/ kha ṭ+wāṃ ga dang thod pa 'dzin pa bsgom pa ni/ bla ma'i gsung gis slob ma'i rgyud la phan 'dogs pa'i rten 'brel yin gsung*/ rdzogs rim dus sems lte bar bstim zhes pa/ sngar tshogs zhing gi dus bsgom pa'i lte ba'i bam̐ yig la'o// thun 'jog dus lus gnad dang ldan pas rang gi lus kyi dbus su dbu ma chos bzhi ldan/ g.yas ro ma me'i rang bzhin dmar po/ g.yon rkyang ma chu'i rang bzhin dkar po bsgoms la/ rtsa gsum po mar sna lte bar zug pa'o// lte bar rje btsun ma mthe bong tsam zhig bsams la/ de las de 'dra ba zhig g.yas ro ma nas mar hril gyis byon/ sna bug g.yas nas 'thon/ nam mkha'i mthar thug pa'i sems can gyi don byas/ sna bug g.yon rkyang ma nas mar zhugs/ lte bar thim pa la rlung bzung*/ yang lte ba'i rje btsun ma las de 'dra ba sprul te/ g.yas ro ma nas zhugs pa sogs sngar bzhin byas la/ mthar lte ba'i rje btsun ma de'i zhabs g.yon gyi ro rkyang la reg pas/ zhabs kyis ro rkyang gnyis bsdus te/ rje btsun ma dbu ma'i nang du yar nur nur byon pas/ ro rkyang gnyis kyang dbu mar rim gyis zhugs/ mthar cha'i gzugs su 'gyur nas dbu mar rtsa gnyis zhugs/ dbu ma yang je thung la song bar bsams la/ sngar gyi rje btsun ma'i sku de mkha' spyod du song bar bsams la/ smon lam bya'o// rje btsun ma'i zhal gdams bla ma sa skya pa'i man ngag*/ gnas gnyis sbyang phyir 'od zer gyis// dag pa'i lha bstan rang la bsdu// rlung la dbang dang cha lam kyang*// gnyis bral ched du zhal shes gsum// lha la rtsa ba su zhal shes// bla ma'i gsungs so//

༈ /phyag rgya chen po dbu mar 'jug pa'i yig chung bzhugs so// ༈ /na mo nā ro ta pa/ phyag rgya chen po dbu mar 'jug pa la/ rlung lus la gnas par bya ba'i thabs ni/ mdzod spur chos kyi 'byung gnas dmar sang nge ba gcig bsam/ de la shes pa gtad de bsgoms pas/ mdzod spur bde ba skye/ de nas dbu ma gro sog gi sbubs tsam nas yar song bas/ spyi gtsug nas mar 'khyog pa'i mtshams su thig le de bzhag de la shes pa gtad/ der bde ba skyes pa dang*/ dbu ma nas mar ba thag tsam du nar gyis song bas/ 'og sgo bde ba chen po'i lam gyi chos 'byung las kyang thal te/ phyir sor phyed gsum tsam du khyug byung ba la lan 'gas mi bzod pa'i bde ba skye/ thig le 'dzag pa snyam byed pa byung ba/ sor phyed phri la gnyis su bye/ des kyang mi bzod ran tsam phri/ des kyang mi bzod na phyir nyung tsam bya/ de ltar byas pas rlung lus la phog pa la sogs pa rkyen gang gis kyang bde ba skye bar gyur pa na/ rlung lus la gnas pa yin no// de nas rlung sems la gnas par bya ste/ sgo rnams yar grol ba'i lam gyis thig le rang la shes pa bzhag pas/ ji tsam na lus med pa snyam byed pa dang*/ 'ja' tshon yin pa snyam byed pa byung tsam na rlung sems la gnas pa yin no// de nas stong pa nyid la sems bzhag pas/ 'od gsal ba mngon du gyur pa ni phyag rgya chen po dbu mar zhugs pa'o// ༈ /dhi/ thun mong ma yin pa'i rtsa dbu ma'i rgyun gyi nyams len gsang chen bcud kyi thig le zhes bya ba bzhugs so// ༈ /na mo gu ru badz+ra wā rā he/ ma lus rgyal ba bskyed pa'i yum mchog ma// grangs med dpa' bo bzhad pa'i g.yo ldan ma// mkha' spyod grong du khrid pa'i sa mkhan ma// bla ma mchog dang dbyer med gang der 'dud// de la 'dir rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i thun mong ma yin pa'i rtsa dbu ma'i khrid kyi rnal 'byor legs par thob pa'i skal bzang gis/

khrid kyi snying po bsdus nas rgyun gyi rnal 'byor du nyams su len tshul ni/ bskyed rim phag mo mkha' spyod kyi rnal 'byor bzlas pa yan chad tshang bar byas/ de rjes rang gi lus kyi dbus drang por rtsa gsum reg la ma 'byar ba'i lte ba sbubs stong dum bu gcig tu gyur pa/ mas sna gsang gnas kyi rtser slebs pa/ yas sna sba gug ltar mdun phyogs su 'khyog pa smin mtshams dang*/ sna bug gnyis la zug par bsam/ lte ba'i sbubs stong du ram̐ yig chung ngu las me 'bar ba'i drod kyis/ rtsa gnas kyi byang sems zhu zhing dwangs snyigs phyed nas/ dwangs ma lte bar 'dus shing*/ a wa dhū tir zhugs pas/ de nyid byang chub kyi sems kyi dwangs mas gang bas/ bde chen gyi ye shes rgyud la skyes par bsams te rlung ro bsal nas rlung kha sbyar nas ci thub 'dzin/ de nas ro rkyang gnyis mi dmigs par bsam/ rtsa dbu ma'i yas sna smin mtshams su chos 'byung dmar seng nge ba gcig bsam/ de'i nang du thig le kha dog sna tshogs pa'i rang bzhin/ khra khrug khrug pa sran ma chung shos tsam gcig bsam/ de la shes pa gtad pas bde ba skyes par bsgom/ yang thig le de nyid gyen du song nas/ tshangs bug gi thad kyi rtsa dbu ma'i nang sleb pa la sngar bzhin sems gtad pas bde ba skyes par bsam/ de rjes thig le de las thig le dkar po ba thag brkyang ba lta bu dkar zhing 'tsher ba bde ba'i rang bzhin can zhig rtsa dbu ma'i nang nas mar nar gyis song*/ gsang gnas kyi rtse'i rtsa dbu ma'i mas snar/ chos 'byung gru gsum dmar po yod pa'i phyir sor phyed dang gsum tsam nyug byung bas bde chen ye shes skyes bar bsams la sems bzung*/ bde ba che ba'i skyon byung na thig le de nyid sor phyed phri la sor gnyis bsgom/ des kyang mi bzod na sor gcig tsam dang*/ chos 'byung gi kha dang mnyam pa tsam skabs su gang babs nyams dang bstun la bya/

de ltar byas pas lus la rlung gi reg bya dang*/ mtshon phog pa la sogs pa'i rkyen gang gis kyang bde ba skye bar 'gyur bas na/ rlung lus la gnas pa'i nyams len yin no// rlung sems la gnas par bya ba ni/ slar yang smin mtshams nas spyi gtsug gi dbu ma'i nang gi thig le la reg sems gtad pas de las 'od zer kha dog sna lnga 'phros pas/ mgo bo nas bzung rim bzhin lus kyi cha shas gang dang gang du slebs pa de thams cad 'od kha dog sna lnga'i rang bzhin du yal gyis song bas mthar 'ja' tshon gyi phung po ltar gyur par bsams nas/ 'dzin med kyi ngang du yang dang yang du mnyam par 'jog dmigs pa la mi gnod na rlung kha sbyar kyang bsgom mo// 'di ni phyag rgya chen po dbu mar 'jug pa'i gdams pa zhes bya ba ches zab pa yin pas/ nyams len la brtson par bya'o// mang po chos kyi zab khyad min// rnal 'byor gsang mtha'i bcud phyung ba'i// gsang chen nyi gzhon gsar pa 'dis// snying dbus pad+mor bzhad gyur cig/ ༈ /e dhi/ nā ro mkha' spyod kyi dbang bzhi lus sgrigs kyi yig chung bzhugs so// ༈ /na mo shrī badz+ra yo gi nī ye/ rje btsun nā ro mkha' spyod kyi zhal shes dbang bzhi lus sgrigs ni/ rang rje btsun mar bsgom pa bum dbang gi lam/ lte bar 'khor lo lnga gsal 'debs pa gsang dbang*/ gsang gnas su dga' ba 'khyil pa la sems gtad pas bde ba'i ye shes skye ba shes rab ye shes/ de rnams bde steng du shes pa dbang bzhi pa'i lam yin gsung*/ 'khor lo lnga lte bar gsal gdab pa ni/ dang po chos 'byung bsgom pa gsang gnas/ gru gsum chos 'byung gnyis pa lte ba sprul 'khor/ zla ba'i dkyil 'khor zlum po snying ga chos 'khor/ bam̐ yig gi ya ra la wa bzhi mtshon pas mgrin pa longs spyod/ bam̐ yig gi mthar oṃ gsum mas bskor ba de spyi bo bde chen te/ dbyangs yig ngo bo sngags phreng gis bskor ba'o// /

ngo bo dga' ba bzhi la/ rnam pa 'khyil par gnas pas dga' ba 'khyil pa'o// grwa bzhi zhes pa zur gyen bstan gsum/ 'og gcig yin no// 'og ma bri cha la med/ de'i rgyu mtshan/ dga' ba'i dga' ba sogs bzhi yin pas/ lhan skyes gzugs dang bral bar bstan pa yin no// zhes gong gi man ngag gnyis po 'di bla ma'i gsung ngo*// / dpal nā ro pas slob ma gzhan la ma gnang zhing*/ pham thing pa sku mched kho na la gnang ba de nyid las brgyud pa'i rje btsun sa skya pa yab sras kyi gdams pa khyad par can 'di nyid/ skal ldan gyi slob ma la chig brgyud kyi tshul du spel ba las/ snod min la mi spel ba'i bka' rgya dam po yod do// legs sbyar gyi gnad bla ma'i zhal la dris/ sa ma ya*// ༈ /ai/ nā ro mkha' spyod kyi dbang bzhi lus sgrigs mkha' spyod sgrub pa 'pho ba rnams kyi zhal shes kyi yig chung bzhugs so// ༈ /'di la rab mkha' spyod du tshegs med du 'gro ba dang*/ 'bring laṅka li ya'i bsgrub pa dang*/ tha ma bskyed rdzogs rgyun mi chad par byas pas bar dor mkha' spyod du 'gro ba yin/ 'di'i rnal 'byor bcu gcig bla ma bsgom pa'i thad du gsung rdo rje dang bskyed rim zin nas bzlas pa'i thad du lha sku bsgom pa dbang dang po'o// snying gar chos 'byung nyis brtsegs kyi steng*/ lte 'og gru gsum gyi oṃ/ snying ga'i bam̐/ mgrin par ya ra la wa/ mtha' bskor so gnyis pos spyi bo bde chen mtshon pa ste/ dbang gnyis pa/ gsang gnas dga' 'khyil bde ba gsum/ de spyi bor 'khyil pa mi 'gul ba bzhin gnas pa mi rtog pa gnas pa bzhi pa mtshon/ bsam mi khyab kyi rnal 'byor gyi tshab ma mkha' spyod bsgrub pa ste/ lte 'og gi aṃ gi rnal 'byor mar gyur/ rtsa gsum ro ma sogs g.yas steng thad sogs rtsa gsum smyug sbubs bzhin/ gnyis snar dang nge*/ gcig spyi bo dang nge*/ rlung phyir 'gro byed tsa na chu nang rdol ba bzhin/

g.yas rtsa nang nas ya gir byung*/ snod bcud kun la 'phros/ der gyur rlung nang du song g.yon nas zhugs/ ma gir thim/ gnas tshe de la sems gtad do// 'jog tshe snod bcud kun rang la/ rang lag g.yas sogs la bsdu/ 'og cha lte ba'i yo gi la bsdu/ rdza ma tsam lus/ de lte 'og la/ rtsa gnyis cha dril bu bzhin lte 'og la byas/ rtsa dbu ma'i nang nas yar hril le/ tsan ne ne/ a haṃ sogs su thim/ mthar ya gi nyid mkha' spyod du rgyang de'i ngang la 'jog gser chos chig brgyud zhal shes 'di bri bar ma gnang*/ tho tsam byas pas bzod par mdzod/ bla ma'i gsung nas 'di 'pho bar 'gro ba 'dug gsung*/ brtan pa thob nas cher mi sto 'dra gsung*/ rnam grangs gsum po zhal shes gdams ngag yin pas gang dran mi bya'o// skal ldan la byin/ 'di ka rang la blo gtad 'cha' na da dung gab yig yod do// bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo// 'og gi lam gnyis brtsegs pa gnyis/ steng gi lam gnyis brtsegs pa gnyis// bar gyi lam lngar rkyang ha ya pa cha zhes gsungs pa bzhin// bshang lam 'di'i gnad zhal las shes dgos k+ṣak+ṣaṃmar+yu// gci bar pak+ṣaṃmarayu// spyi gtsug hahaṃmar+yu dang*// mdzod spu yayaṃmar+yu// gnyis gnyis la ni rim pa bzhin// ser dkar dkar dang ser po'o// sna gnyis yum̐ dmar rna gnyis ser// mig gnyis dang ni lce chung rtsar// sum̐ dang lce bar k+ṣuṃ yig rnams// rim bzhin sngo dang dkar dmar po// tshul 'di bla ma'i gsung bzhin du// bris pa yid la gzung mdzod cig /gsung rab rnams su mi 'dra yang*// gang de gzung la gang zhig mdor// bla ma'i gsung nyid tshad ma yin// bshang lam 'phos na dmyal bar skye// zhes sogs rgyud las gsal bar 'byung*/ sa mā ya// ༈ / he ru ka yab yum zhal sbyor dang*/ yum rkyang la brten pa'i 'pho ba gser chos mal lo tsā ba'i man ngag sa chen gyis mdzad pa bzhugs so// ༈ /na mo gu ru ḍā ki ni/

nā ro mkha' spyod kyi 'pho ba la sbyang ba dang*/ las la sbyar ba gnyis/ dang po ni/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed byas la rang rnal 'byor mar bsgoms pa'i mdun gyi spyi bor rin po che dang*/ pad nyi'i steng du bla ma he ru ka'i mtha' mar dpa' bo mkha' 'gro thams cad kyis bskor nas bzhugs par bsam/ rtsa brgyud kyi bla ma dang phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas rnams spyan drangs la bstim/ gus pa'i gsol ba gdab/ de nas rang gi spyi gtsug nas lte ba'i bar du rtsa dbu ma sba lcag 'bring po tsam kha dog rgya skyegs ltar ldem me zug pa gsal btab gsang gnas rlung gi dkyil 'khor g.yo ba dang bcas pa/ lte 'og tu nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ rang gi rnam shes kyi ngo bo rdo rje rnal 'byor ma mtshon gang pa/ sku mdog dmar hril hril byed pa gsal bar dmigs la/ nam mkha'i dpa' bo mkha' 'gro rnams kyis 'ja' dang*/ 'od dang*/ gdugs dang*/ rol mo'i sgra sna tshogs dang*/ me tog gi char chen po phab nas/ 'og rlung 'then pas/ gsang gnas rlung gi dkyil 'khor g.yo zhing*/ rang sems rnal 'byor ma dbu ma'i lam nas dmar rgyang ste spyi bo nas phul/ bla ma'i thugs kar byon/ rlung rngubs pas/ mar la lte bar byon/ rlung bum pa can bzung*/ de ltar yang yang bzung ba'i mthar rtsa dbu ma'i lam nas/ rnal 'byor ma lte ba dang*/ bla ma snying gar byon nas/ zhal sprod du byon pa la sems gtad cing*/ spros bral la mnyam par bzhag go /rjes su bsngo ba bya/ 'byongs pa'i tshad spyi bo na skam pa/ skrangs pa dang*/ za ba dang*/ spos dri dang*/ 'ja' 'od dang*/ rol mo'i sgra la sogs pa 'byung ngo*// gnyis pa las la sbyar ba la/ dngos po rnams bla ma dang*/ dkon mchog gi phyogs su btang la/ chags zhen thams cad spangs la/ rang sems rnal 'byor ma dbu ma'i lam nas rgyangs te spyi bo nas bud/ bla ma he ru ka'i thugs kar thim/ dbyer med du 'dres/

me tog gi char dang*/ 'ja' 'od dang*/ gdugs dang rol mo'i sgra la sogs pas mkha' spyod du gshegs/ bla ma mal lo tsā ba'i gser chos bka' rgya ma// /rang rdo rje rnal 'byor mar bsgoms pa'i rtsa dbu ma'i mas snar chos 'byung gi nang du/ rang gi rnam shes kyi ngo bo bam̐ yig dmar po gcig bsam/ rang gi spyi bor chos 'byung gi dbus su bh+rūm̐ las seṅge chen po brgyad kyis btegs pa'i steng du pad+ma dang nyi zla'i gdan bzhi brtsegs pa'i steng du/ rtsa ba'i bla ma mkha' spyod rdo rje rnal 'byor mar bsgoms la/ rtsa brgyud kyi bla ma phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' yi dam rgyud sde bzhi dang 'brel ba'i lha tshogs/ mkha' 'gro chos skyong srung ma'i lha tshogs dang bcas pa sprin 'khrigs pa ltar spyan drangs la stim/ phyi nang gi mchod pa dang bstod pa bya/ gsol ba btab pa ni dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ngo bo bla ma mkha' spyod rdo rje rnal 'byor ma la gsol ba 'debs so// bdag 'dzin blo yis thongs par byin gyis rlobs// dgos med rgyud la skye bar byin gyis rlobs// lam mchog 'pho ba 'byongs par byin gyis rlobs// 'phyugs med mkha' spyod 'grub par byin gyis rlabs// zhes gsol ba btab la 'og rlung 'then te/ rang gi rnam shes bam̐ yig a wa dhū ti'i nang du zhugs nas/ spyi bo nas rgyangs kyis rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i lte bar zhugs nas bam̐ yig la thim par bsam/ de nas yang mar log nas bam̐ yig la thim par bsam/ dbugs 'byung rngubs gnyis dang bstun nas/ thun gsum mam bzhir bsgom/ thun mtshams su spyi bo'i rnal 'byor ma lte bar bsdus la/ spyod lam bya'o// las sbyor la/ bam̐ yig rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i lte ba'am/ thugs kar rgyangs kyis 'phangs la/ bar do med par rdo rje rnal 'byor mar gyur nas mkha' spyod du gshegs pa yin no// mkha' spyod la 'pho ba gser chos mal lo tsā ba'i man ngag zab mo//
bka' rgya/ dam rgya/ tshig rgya// / ༈ /

mkha' spyod zhal bzang blta ba'i smon lam bzhugs so// ༈ /na mo badz+ra tsaṇ+ḍa li ye/ mtha' yas rgyal ba'i bde stong zlos gar ni// srid zhi'i mig 'phrul cir yang snang ba las// deng 'dir mkha' spyod dpal mo yid 'ong ma// snying nas dran no 'khyud pa'i rtse dgas skyongs// 'og min zhing na lhan skyes rgyal yum ma// nyer bzhi'i yul na zhing skyes ḍā ki ma// nor 'dzin khyab pa'i karma mu dra ma// rnal 'byor bdag gi skyabs mchog rje btsun ma// khyod ni sems nyid stong ba'i rang rtsal te// rdo rje'i grong na e dbyings wam̐ gyi dngos// sgyu ma'i gling na 'jigs rung srin mo dang*// 'dzum zhal mdzes pa'i lang tsho gsal bar ston// bdag gis ji ltar btsal kyang 'phags ma khyed// bden par grub pa'i nges pa ma rnyed pas// spros pas dub pa'i sems kyi gzhon nu de// brjod bral nags kyi khang bur ngal bso brten// e ma da ni ḍā ki dbyings nas bzhengs// he ru ka dpal rgyud kyi rgyal po las// rdo rje btsun mo nye ba'i snying po mchog /bklags pas 'grub ces gsungs pa'i bden pas skyongs// au ḍī bi sha bas mtha'i nags khrod du// grub pa'i dbang po rdo rje dril bu pa// 'khyud dang tsum bha'i bde bas rjes skyongs ltar// mkha' spyod mchog gis rol zhing bdag kyang skyongs// gaṅga'i gling du rje btsun ku sā li// mngon sum nam mkha'i dbyings su khrid pa dang*// dpal ldan nā ro ta pas rjes bzung ltar// bdag kyang mkha' spyod dga' ma'i grong du khrid// rtsa brgyud bla ma mchog gi byin rlabs dang*// rgyud chen gsang mtha'i myur lam zab khyad dang*// rnal 'byor bdag gi lhag bsam dag pa'i mthus// mkha' spyod dga' ma'i 'dzum zhal myur mthong shog/ ༈ / rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i bkra shis dge legs kyi dpal ster bzhugs so// ༈ /oṃ swa sti sid+dhaṃ/

bla ma yi dam rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// phun tshogs dge legs kun gyi dpal mnga' ba// rdo rje 'chang chen paṇa chen nā ro sogs// dpal ldan bla ma dam pa'i tshogs rnams kyi// byin rlabs myur du 'jug pa'i bkra shis shog /rgyal ba'i yum mchog shes rab pha rol phyin// rang bzhin 'od gsal gdod nas spros dang bral// brtan g.yo'i dngos kun spro dang sdud mdzad ma// mkha' spyod chos kyi sku yi bkra shis shog /mtshan dpe'i dpal 'bar rab mdzes brjid pa'i sku// drug cu'i dbyangs ldan theg mchog sgrogs pa'i gsung*// ye shes lnga ldan 'od gsal mi rtog thugs// lhan skyes longs spyod rdzogs sku'i bkra shis shog /sna tshogs zhing du sna tshogs gzugs sku yis// sna tshogs thabs kyis sna tshogs gdul bya'i don// sna tshogs bsam pa ji bzhin sgrub mdzad ma// zhing skyes sprul pa'i sku yi bkra shis shog /pad+ma ra ga'i mdog mtshungs rje btsun ma// 'dzum khro'i nyams ldan zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyis// gri thod legs 'dzin zhabs gnyis brkyangs bskum tshul// sngags skyes mkha' spyod mchog gi bkra shis shog /gang gi rnam 'phrul grangs med bye ba phrag /stong phrag bdun cu rtsa gnyis tshogs rnams kyis// sgrub pa po yi bar chad kun sel cing*// 'dod don dngos grub stsol ba'i bkra shis shog /rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i bkra shis dge legs kyi dpal ster zhes bya ba byams pa chos legs kyis bde ldan ri khrod du sbyar ba'o// nā ro mkha' spyod kyi thugs dam gang byed kyi mjug tu bkra shis 'di byas pas shin tu longs spyod che ba 'dug pas byed pa gal che che// // ༈ bal yul mchod rten nye 'dabs nas rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa las/ slob bu tha shal pa gu rus spel ba'o//
